title: Pankaj Tripathi says 'Mirzapur' shattered industry myth about star-driven films being BO pull
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Star Pankaj Tripathi says the success of "Mirzapur: The Movie" and "Hanuman Ansh" has challenged the notion that actors who are not known for delivering big openings cannot draw audiences to theatres.

Adding to this, Pankaj Tripathi says 'Mirzapur' shattered industry myth about star-driven films being BO pull "Mirzapur: The Movie", a big-screen continuation of the popular series, rolled out in September to universal praise and minted ₹ 229.60 crore rupees nett at the India ticket-window.
Meanwhile, The movie followed three successful seasons of the show, which built a loyal audience for its characters.
Notably, It saw Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Divyenndu reprise their popular characters Kaleen Bhaiya, Guddu Pandit and Munna, respectively, along with other members of the original cast.

As per the latest buzz, "I feel of late two misconceptions have been shattered with regards to theatrical releases. One that a movie can be a smash hit in the third week of its rollout, as it happened in case of 'Hanuman Ansh'.

In further updates, "And another is that, even actors who don't typically get a big opening are capable of delivering one. So, these two instances have happened in the same month. The experts usually make some other narrative but the audience has shown that if they like something, they show all their love," Tripathi shared on day two of Jagran Movie Festival here.
On top of that, With "Mirzapur: The Movie", the star attributed the movie's success to the enduring popularity of its characters, who continue to draw audiences to cinemas.

"The audience has relatability with the characters of 'Mirzapur', they enjoy watching them and hence they went to theatres to watch the movie. People liked that world and the characters," he shared, adding that the duration of the movie will be a bit longer on OTT as compared to theatrical rollout.

title: Bhushan Kumar backs Rishab Shetty’s two-part film on Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, shoot begins early 2027
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kannada star Rishab Shetty will take on the role of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in a two-part historical epic backed by Bhushan Kumar and filmmaker Sandeep Singh. Titled The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the movie will chronicle the Maratha king’s life, his achievements and his vision of Swarajya. The makers are expected to begin shooting in early 2027. Bhumi Pednekar, Arjun Rampal and Vivek Oberoi have also been linked to the project in earlier reports.

Adding to this, Rishab Shetty to play Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in Bhushan Kumar and Sandeep Singh’s two-part historical epic. The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj collaboration The two-part saga will trace his journey through some of the most significant battles and victories, along with the sacrifices and lesser-known episodes that shaped his legacy. His sharp military mind, fearless leadership and determination to establish Swarajya will be central to the story. As a gesture to mark the association, Bhushan presented Rishab with a century-old painting of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.

Meanwhile, Speaking about the movie, producer Bhushan Kumar shared, “Maharashtra and Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj have given us a legacy to be proud of, and I believe it is our responsibility to honour that legacy through cinema and share it with the world. When Sandeep Singh narrated The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, I felt a deep sense of responsibility to bring this extraordinary story to the big screen. With Rishab Shetty’s powerful screen presence and his ability to bring legendary figures to life, I believe we have the right combination to bring the courage, vision and spirit of Swarajya to audiences across generations. For T-Series, this is more than a movie; it is a tribute to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and his timeless legacy.”

Notably, The makers are currently working on pre-production, with the movie expected to go on floors in early 2027. The two-part project will feature a large ensemble cast and a crew comprising Indian and international talent. The intention is to bring lesser-known aspects of Shivaji Maharaj's life to the forefront while celebrating the values and vision that continue to inspire generations.

As per the latest buzz, Presented by Gulshan Kumar and T-Series Films, the movie is a T-Series Films and Legend Studios production. Sandeep Singh will direct the project, with Bhushan Kumar and Krishan Kumar as producers. Rishi Virmani and Sandeep Singh have written the movie, while Rishab Shetty, Shiv Chanana and Kabiir Sadanand are attached as co-producers.

title: Parineeti Chopra ends Karwa Chauth fast at 35,000 feet, shares video from plane with Raghav Chadha: ‘You make all my dreams come true'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Several Bollywood celebrities celebrated Karwa Chauth on Thursday and shared glimpses of their celebrations on social media. Star Parineeti Chopra marked the festival in a special way this year, showing that distance and circumstances cannot come in the way of traditions. The star shared a video from a flight, giving followers a glimpse of how she celebrated the festival with her husband, politician Raghav Chadha , at 35,000 feet.

Adding to this, Parineeti Chopra and Raghav Chadha celebrate Karwa Chauth in a plane. Parineeti Chopra and Raghav Chadha celebrate Karwa Chauth in airplane Taking to Instagram on Thursday, Parineeti shared a video featuring herself and Raghav inside the plane. The couple were seen spotting the moon before Parineeti broke her fast mid-air. Raghav fed her water and food as she completed the ritual. Sharing the video, Parineeti wrote, “Karwa chauth is wherever we are. Even if its at 35000 feet! 🤗🥰” Praising her husband, she added, “You make all my dreams come true Ragaji. The best man, the best human, the best boii." The star was seen wearing a traditional suit and flaunting her sindoor as she celebrated the festival.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Parineeti Chopra (@parineetichopra)

Notably, The video reminded several followers of Priyanka Chopra's Karwa Chauth anecdote. During an appearance on The Kapil Sharma Show in 2025, Priyanka opened up that her husband, Nick Jonas, had taken her on a plane above the clouds to help her break her Karwa Chauth fast when the moon was not visible. She shared, "We’ve tried to spot the moon in the strangest places. Once, we were at a stadium where he was doing a show, and the moon just wouldn’t appear. There were clouds, and rain was about to start. Around 60–70 thousand people were present and the show kept going on. We waited till 10 pm, then 11 pm, and still the moon wasn’t visible. Want to hear something romantic? He finally took me up in a plane, above the clouds, and then I broke my fast after seeing the moon."

The couple tied the knot on September 24, 2023, at The Leela Palace in Udaipur, Rajasthan, in the presence of their family members and close friends.

title: Ali Fazal, Pankaj Tripathi's Mirzapur: The Movie arrives on Prime Video with a special extended cut and unseen footage
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

The world of Mirzapur is back on screens, and this time, followers have a little more to look forward to. After its theatrical rollout, Mirzapur: The Movie has arrived on Prime Video on October 30, bringing back the familiar faces, power struggles and rivalries that have kept audiences hooked to the franchise. There is an added treat for followers too, with the streaming version featuring an extended cut that includes scenes not seen in the theatrical rollout.

Adding to this, Mirzapur: The Movie is now on Prime Video, and there's more bhaukaal for followers to watch. Mirzapur: The Movie revisits the world of Purvanchal Set during the timeline of Season 1, Mirzapur: The Movie explores an untold chapter, with the fight for the throne taking the characters beyond Purvanchal and into the desert. While the familiar power games remain at the heart of the story, the movie takes the franchise into a new setting. The extended version on Prime Video also gives viewers a few more reasons to tune in. It features never-before-seen scenes that did not make it into the theatrical cut, offering additional footage from the world of Mirzapur. The movie was A-rated in cinemas and the runtime was 3 hours 17 minutes. Meanwhile, the runtime of the extended cut is 3 hours and 31 minutes on Prime Video.

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram Gurmmeet Singh on bringing Mirzapur to cinemas Director Gurmmeet Singh spoke about the excitement of bringing the movie to a much wider audience through its streaming premiere. He shared, “With Mirzapur: The Movie, the idea was to take a world that audiences know so well and explore how it could unfold on a larger canvas. As a director, it was exciting to approach these characters in a new way while staying true to the grit and intensity that define Mirzapur. The world of Mirzapur has always received immense love from audiences, and as the movie premieres on Prime Video, I’m excited for even more viewers to experience it. As a surprise for followers, the movie also features an extended cut with never-before-seen scenes, giving audiences more to discover in a world they have always loved.”

Notably, For Excel Entertainment producers Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar, the movie marked a new experience for a franchise that had built a loyal following through streaming. They also acknowledged the response to its theatrical rollout and hope its arrival on Prime Video brings more viewers into the Mirzapur universe.

As per the latest buzz, They shared in a note, “The love that audiences have shown Mirzapur over the years, and the connection they have with its characters, has been incredibly special to us. Taking the franchise to the big screen was a new experience for us, and we’re happy to see the movie receive so much love. As it now makes its way to OTT, we hope it reaches even more people and gives followers another chance to revisit the world of Mirzapur.”

In further updates, Devraj Sanyal, Managing Director of Universal Music India, opened up that this special cut was the one the makers had watched before the rollout. He wrote on Instagram, “ This extended cut is the version we watched before the movie’s official rollout. What reached cinemas was a shorter cut. And this one? Absolutely insane. This movie has been gratifying on so many levels. A ticket-window smash. The coming alive of one of India’s most successful stories of all time. Music that has been received spectacularly, with songs I believe we’ll be listening to for a very, very long time. And now, finally, you can watch it at home on Amazon Prime Video. Get together for a watch party. Watch it on your own, with people you love, with fellow followers, or with your community. Watch it any way you like. Just go right ahead, dive in and have fun. I promise you, this is one of the most incredible watches you’ll have in a long time. 🎬.”

On top of that, Presented by Amazon MGM Studios and Excel Entertainment, the movie has been written by Puneet Krishna and directed by Gurmmeet Singh. Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar have produced it under the Excel Entertainment banner.

The cast features Ali Fazal , Pankaj Tripathi and Divyenndu , along with Jitendra Kumar, Ravi Kishan, Abhishek Banerjee, Rasika Dugal, Mohit Malik, Sheeba Chaddha, Rajesh Tailang, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Harshita Gaur, Shweta Tripathi Sharma, Sonal Chauhan, Anangsha Biswas, Shaji Chaudhary, Satendra Soni, Kulbhushan Kharbanda and Sushant Singh.

title: Bhushan Kumar, Rishab Shetty collaborate on two-part Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj biopic
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Producer Bhushan Kumar has joined hands with star-filmmaker Rishab Shetty and filmmaker Sandeep Singh for "The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj", a two-part historical epic that is scheduled to begin production in early 2027.

Adding to this, Bhushan Kumar, Rishab Shetty collaborate on two-part Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj biopic Bhushan's banner T-Series has come on board as a producer for the project, which will be directed by Singh, with Shetty attached as co-producer, the studio shared in a note.
Meanwhile, The movie will chronicle the life and legacy of the Maratha ruler, focusing on his military campaigns, leadership and vision of Swarajya.

Notably, The announcement brings together Kumar, known for backing several successful Hindi movie productions through T-Series, and Shetty, who gained wider national recognition with the Kannada movie "Kantara" .
As per the latest buzz, As part of the announcement, Kumar presented Shetty with a century-old painting of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, marking the beginning of their collaboration.

In further updates, The two-part saga will explore key battles, victories, sacrifices and lesser-known episodes from the life of the 17th-century ruler. The makers are planning an ensemble cast and an international creative team for the project.

On top of that, "Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Maharashtra have given us a legacy to be proud of, and I believe it is our responsibility to honour that legacy through cinema and share it with the world," Kumar shared.

He added that Singh's narration of the story convinced him to take up the project, while Shetty's screen presence and ability to portray larger-than-life characters would bring the historical figure to the screen.

title: Anticipatory bail denied to three booked for allegedly misappropriating ₹4 crore from funds for Kartik Aaryan and Karan Johar's Naagzilla
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

A sessions court in Mumbai has denied anticipatory bail to three movie production executives accused of misappropriating more than ₹ 3.92 crore rupees during the making of the soon-to-release Dharma Productions movie Naagzilla .

Adding to this, Karan Johar and Kartik Aaryan are collaborating on Naagzilla. Court denies bail in Naagzilla fund misappropriation case On Wednesday, Additional Sessions Judge (Dindoshi court) M Mohiuddin also ruled that there was prima facie material against them about their involvement in the offence, news agency PTI reported. The court maintained that the custodial interrogation of the accused was necessary for a detailed investigation into the matter

Meanwhile, Naagzilla stars Kartik Aaryan and is co-produced by Karan Johar's Dharma Productions and Mahaveer Jain Films. The three accused are consultant and signing authority Kuldeep Singh Champawat (47), service provider and executive producer Mahipal Karan Rathore (42), and line producer Shivkumar Tiwari (45). The PTI report shared that an FIR was lodged by Tukaram Mahadev Sawant, an accountant with Mahaveer Jain Films Pvt. Ltd, which is led by Mahaveer Jain and his wife, Neetu Jain.

Notably, Mahaveer Jain Films entered into an agreement with Dharma Productions Pvt. Ltd. to produce Naagzilla with a total budget of ₹ 82.50 crore rupees on October 30 last year. According to the complaint, Kuldeep Singh Champawat approached Mahaveer Jain to handle the movie's production and subsequently recommended his relative, Rathore, who was appointed as a service provider. Tiwari was hired as the line producer to onboard vendors for vehicles, makeup, and junior artistes.

As per the latest buzz, The prosecution has alleged that the three colluded to bypass the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and incurred unaccounted expenditure of ₹ 3,92,76,308 without submitting requisite bills or vouchers.

In further updates, The complaint also alleges that the accused inflated a vendor's bill from ₹ 85,000 to ₹ 1.30 lakh and paid ₹ 45,000 to a firm named ANM Global that rendered no services to the movie. In addition, they have also been accused of clearing over ₹ 1.50 lakh in fabricated bills prepared with a production assistant
On top of that, The investigating officer of the case informed the court that the accused extracted commissions and mobile handsets from vendors to award work and clear bills.

Naagzilla is directed by Mrighdeep Singh Lamba, written by Gautam Mehra and produced by Karan Johar, Mahaveer Jain, Adar Poonawalla, Apoorva Mehta, Mrighdeep Singh Lamba, and Neetu M Jain under Dharma Productions and Mahaveer Jain Films. It is co-produced by Marijke deSouza and Divyansh Jain. Kartik plays an icchadhari naag (shapeshifting snake) in the movie. The movie is set to rollout in theatres next year.

title: Ranbir Kapoor's distant cousin Siddharth P Malhotra says he will watch Ramayana for 'Lakshman' Ravie Dubey first
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana is one of the most anticipated films of the year. With the rollout date approaching (November 5), followers are eagerly waiting to watch the mythological epic on the big screen. While many are looking forward to seeing Ranbir Kapoor in the role of Lord Rama, filmmaker Siddharth P Malhotra, who is also Ranbir's distant cousin, has opened up that he is particularly excited to watch the movie for Ravie Dubey .

Adding to this, Siddharth P Malhotra reveals he's dying to watch Ramayana. Siddharth P Malhotra says he's dying to watch Ramayana In a conversation with NDTV, Siddharth shared he was 'dying' to watch Ramayana, but added that Ravie was his primary reason for looking forward to the movie. He shared, "I am dying to watch it. I love the look, but I love Ravi Dubey in it, because Ravi Dubey is someone I've launched, and Ravi Dubey is a brother to me, and I'm rooting for Ravi in the movie, who's playing Lakshman. And I'm excited, and I'm actually watching the movie for Ravi first before Ranbir... Because Ravi is a brother to me, a younger brother to me, and he's someone I really love as a human being. So my reason to watch Ramayana is, of course, Ramayana, but it's first for Ravie Dubey." Siddharth launched Ravie in the television industry with Yahan Ke Hum Sikandar.

Meanwhile, Siddharth is related to Ranbir Kapoor through the Kapoor family. His grandfather was veteran star Prem Nath, who was the brother of Krishna Malhotra, wife of Raj Kapoor. Notably, He also expressed his desire to work with Ranbir, saying, "It's a dream to work with Ranbir Kapoor. He's the best star in the country. But Ranbir Kapoor has the top of the top to choose from; why would he choose me unless I give him something that is beyond what the top of the top can give him? Why would he choose me? So I have to work hard to earn Ranbir Kapoor. He's not going to come easy. Or Alia Bhatt."

As per the latest buzz, Siddharth added that he considers Ranbir and Alia the best actors in the industry, stressing that their talent, rather than their movie-family backgrounds, is what sets them apart. He also shared that everyone wants to work with them, making it extremely difficult for filmmakers to get an opportunity to collaborate with the two actors.

title: Rakul Preet Singh says Surpanakha is a very misunderstood character, calls Ramayana India's representation to the world
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ramayana is the biggest rollout of the year. After the first trailer that was unveiled by the makers, it went widely shared over the looks of Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama to Sai Pallavi as Sita. Many on the internet debated on the look of the characters as well as the scale of the epic adaptation. But if there was one highlight from the trailer that took everyone by surprise, it was Rakul Preet Singh 's glimpse as Surpanakha.

Adding to this, Rakul Preet Singh's Surpanakha was one of the few highlights of the Ramayana trailer. What Rakul shared Now, in an interaction with news agency PTI, Rakul has shared her excitement on taking up the role of Surpanakha and shared, “I think what was so exciting were a couple of things. First, it's India's representation to the world. Our history, our truth represented to the world's first ever-global movie. Secondly, Surpanakha is a very misunderstood and layered character. She was the reason why the war took place in the first place. So it has been really interesting to play someone with multiple shades.”

Meanwhile, Earlier, the star had reposted a fan letter on her X account with a note. It read, "Thank you for this beautiful letter. What made me say yes to Surpanakha was exactly what you mentioned - her complexity. History often remembers her for one moment, but there is so much more to her story. As an star, roles that challenge perception are the most exciting. I hope audiences discover her with an open mind when Ramayana arrives. (folded hands emoticon)"

Notably, As per Hindu mythology, Suparnakha was the root cause behind the battle between Ravana and Rama. In order to avenge the insult of Surpanakha, Ravana disguised himself as a sage and kidnapped Sita, which ultimately led to the war.

As per the latest buzz, Ramayana is the latest adaptation of Valmiki's epic, one of the world's oldest pieces of literature. It tells the story of Lord Rama, the incarnation of Lord Vishnu (played by Ranbir Kapoor), and his battle against the asura king Ravana (played by Yash) after the latter abducts his wife, Sita (played by Sai Pallavi). The epic is one of the most familiar stories in the Indian subcontinent and is revered by Hindus as a sacred text.

In further updates, As per reports mounted on a budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees"> ₹ 4,000 crore rupees , the movie is backed by Yash and Namit Malhotra and is planned as a two-part franchise. The first instalment is scheduled to rollout in theatres on November 5, 2026, with the second part expected to arrive around Diwali 2027.

title: Sunny Deol was apprehensive about OTT 'debut' with a non-action film like Ikka right after Border 2, recalls Netflix's Ruchikaa Kapoor Sheikh
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

After more than 40 years of giving theatrical hits, Sunny Deol surprised one and all with his streaming debut in 2026. The star starred in Netflix ’s Ikka, directed by Siddharth P Malhotra. The legal drama, which also starred Akshaye Khanna, was a success on the platform, reaching the number one spot in its first few days.

Adding to this, Sunny Deol played a righteous lawyer in Ikka. Ruchikaa Kapoor Sheikh, Director, Original Films, Netflix India, takes Hindustan Times behind the scenes of how the streamer convinced the superstar to opt for a streaming movie and how he let go of his action-hero image for the courtroom drama.

Meanwhile, Ruchikaa recalls that Sunny was initially apprehensive about the movie because it had no action, which has been his USP for close to four decades. “We were working on Ikka with Sunny sir, and he was worried that there was no action. And I told him, ‘That's the beauty of doing streaming. We'll take a familiar genre like a courtroom drama, put you in the genre, and we're going to see where it goes.’

Notably, Ruchikaa says the star was still apprehensive when she assured him, saying, “Two months later, either I'll tell you, we should have put one action scene, or you'll call me and say this was not a bad idea. So, let's see where it goes,” she says.

As per the latest buzz, She adds that she felt the freshness and novelty of the idea was what appealed to the audience. “I'm not going to blow your mind after the hand pump (scene from Gadar). We have Border and Jaat on our service. People are watching that. But if I'm going to look at original films to be able to stand on their own two feet, it has to be a complementary offering: getting someone you love in a genre that you like to click and stay on.”

In further updates, Ikka happened to be Sunny’s streaming debut. Having been a theatrical star for four decades, it was a brave move for the star. Ruchikaa recalls telling Sunny several times that it was time for him to ‘debut’ on Netflix. To which the star laughed and shared, “I'm 60 years old. How can I debut?”

On top of that, Ikka, Ruchikaa admits, was an unusual streaming debut for the star who has seen a second wind to his career on the back of action extravaganzas like Gadar 2, Border 2, and Jaat. “He shared, ‘Are you sure? Border abhi aayi hai (Border 2 has just rolled out).’” But eventually he came around, Ruchikaa recalls. "I'm going with the conviction that you guys have, and I'm going to give you my all," is what he told the team.

But Ruchikaa maintains that the movie's makers, including those at Netflix, were never unsure about it. “I don't want to say we were nervous. It was him and his A game, him and his element,” she explains.

title: Junglywood trailer out: Shaan R Grover leads a thriller set against Bollywood’s insider-outsider divide
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The trailer centres on a secret party where tensions between industry insiders and outsiders come to the fore. As the characters navigate the clash, the story examines the struggles and ambitions of people trying to establish themselves in the movie industry.

Adding to this, The debate around nepotism and opportunities for people without movie industry connections has remained a recurring subject in Hindi cinema. Junglywood approaches the subject through a fictional narrative, using the movie industry as the setting for a story involving competing interests and shifting power dynamics.

Meanwhile, Director Chand Mohammad shared he wanted to combine the style of classic cinema with contemporary storytelling. He also opened up that the movie was made without visual effects, relying instead on performances, atmosphere and practical filmmaking.

Notably, “With JUNGLYWOOD , I wanted to create a movie that brings the soul of old-school cinema into the world of modern storytelling. My vision was to make a new-age movie using classic cinematic techniques, relying on practical filmmaking, strong performances, atmosphere, and storytelling rather than visual effects. There is no VFX in the movie, and that was a conscious creative choice,” he shared.
As per the latest buzz, Explaining why he chose the movie industry as the setting, Chand shared the stories unfolding behind the scenes can be as compelling as the films audiences watch.

In further updates, “I chose Bollywood as the backdrop because I have always felt that the stories unfolding behind the glamour are just as fascinating as the films we see on screen. People have an incredible curiosity about the industry, its power dynamics, its ambitions, and the personalities within it,” the director shared.
On top of that, He added that the movie aims to offer an entertaining and unpredictable experience while exploring the contradictions of the industry.
“ JUNGLYWOOD is designed to be a fun, edgy, and thrilling cinematic experience, with unexpected turns and twists that stay with you long after the movie ends,” Chand shared.

title: Udta Teer box office collection day 7: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan film maintains momentum, crosses ₹30 in first week
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan ’s spy comedy Udta Teer has crossed the ₹ 30-crore rupees mark at the domestic ticket-window in its opening week, showing steady collections despite competition from other theatrical releases. The movie, which opened to positive reviews, witnessed a strong jump over its first weekend before settling into weekday collections.

Adding to this, Ayushmann Khurrana plays a Pakistani spy in Udta Teer. Udta Teer first week haul Udta Teer opened with ₹ 4.10 crore rupees on Friday, October 23. Saturday brought a noticeable improvement, as collections rose to ₹ 7.25 crore rupees, a jump of around 76% from the opening day. The upward trend continued on Sunday, when the movie collected ₹ 8.20 crore rupees. The latest update from Sacnilk states that the movie managed to collect ₹ 2.60 crore rupees on Thursday, which did not show a dip from its previous day's haul. This brings the total ticket-window earnings of the movie to ₹ 31.25 crore rupees after its first week.
Meanwhile, Udta Teer faced heat at the ticket-window with the rollout of a mammoth movie like Jailer 2 , starring Rajinikanth in the lead, just a week before.

Notably, The movie follows a Pakistani spy, played by Ayushmann, who loses his memory after a blast and begins to believe that he is an Indian Counter-Terrorism Squad officer. His mistaken identity sets off a chain of comic and action-packed events as he becomes caught up in a cross-border espionage operation.

As per the latest buzz, Ayushmann of late opened up about working with producer Guneet Monga , pointing out that they have a similar approach to choosing stories. The star shared, “Guneet and I share a very common core when it comes to content. I've always been drawn to clutter-breaking, unique cinema, and Guneet has championed distinctive storytelling in her own way, taking Indian stories to a global platform and representing India at the Oscars. And it is this synergy that makes this movie so exciting. With Udta Teer, we're bringing that shared vision to a genre-breaking entertainer that blends patriotism, action and comedy."

Recalling their history, Ayushmann added, “She took my first ever audition, so we go back a long way. title: Ranbir Kapoor, Nitesh Tiwari, and others discuss Ramayana’s values with students from 500 schools; special episode to stream on JioHotstar
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

Organised by JioHotstar in partnership with the makers of Ramayana and the International Institute of Management and Entrepreneurship (I.I.M.U.N.), the initiative brought together nearly 20,000 students from more than 500 schools across 18 cities. The event aimed to explore how the epic’s themes of duty, courage, friendship, love, forgiveness and sacrifice continue to resonate with younger audiences.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor, who plays Lord Rama in the soon-to-release movie Ramayana: Part One , shared interacting with students gave him an opportunity to hear how a new generation interprets the character. “Rama’s story has been part of our lives for generations, and stepping into his shoes has been an incredibly humbling experience. What made this interaction special was hearing young minds engage with his story in their own way,” Ranbir shared.
Meanwhile, He added that the conversation reminded him how different generations can find their own meaning in Rama’s journey while continuing to connect with its familiar themes.

Notably, The event took place at I.I.M.U.N.’s headquarters in Mumbai, with around 150 student leaders attending in person and others participating virtually from classrooms across the country. Students asked the guests questions about the epic’s central characters and their decisions. The discussion included who they considered the true hero of the Ramayana, what they would ask Lord Rama, which character they would choose as a friend and whose journey among Rama, Sita and Lakshman they found most challenging.

As per the latest buzz, Producer Namit Malhotra shared the conversation was an opportunity to help young people develop their own understanding of the epic. “Ramayana has given us generations of stories, values and lessons that continue to guide us even today. As we bring this epic to the big screen, it’s equally important that young people discover these values and find their own connection with them,” he shared.
In further updates, Malhotra added that the students’ curiosity and perspectives demonstrated how the story continues to connect with new generations.

On top of that, Director Nitesh Tiwari shared the Ramayana’s appeal lies not only in its larger-than-life events but also in the personal choices and emotions of its characters. “The richness of Ramayana lies in the fact that alongside its larger-than-life moments, its characters face deeply human choices and emotions. As filmmakers, our responsibility was to preserve that emotional truth while bringing the story to the screen for a new generation,” Tiwari shared.

Ravie Dubey, who portrays Lakshman in the movie, reflected on the relationship between Lakshman and Rama, which is shaped by loyalty, love and duty. “Playing Lakshman gave me the opportunity to explore a relationship built on loyalty, love and an unwavering sense of duty. What I found interesting during this interaction was how young people viewed these relationships and choices from their own experiences,” Dubey shared.

title: BREAKING: Ram Gopal Varma in LEGAL TROUBLE over Rs. 29.67 crores! Production house warns filmmakers, OTT platforms against dealing with RGV without NOC
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The public notice, issued in 24th and 31st October 2026, issue of Atul Mohan's Complete Cinema magazine, states that Eclatant Films had issued a legal notice to Ram Gopal Varma on October 15, calling upon him to clear outstanding dues amounting to Rs. 29,67,64,000. Interestingly, the amount includes accumulated interest of Rs. 11,38,92,000.

Adding to this, According to the notice, the dispute stems from an agreement dated April 10, 2010. Eclatant Films has also referred to an order passed by the Bombay High Court on April 17, 2013, in connection with the agreement. The company has demanded that the filmmaker settle the outstanding amount by October 30, 2026. Failing this, it has warned that it would assert its contractual lien over RGV's share, rights, interests, revenues and exploitation rights in films and projects covered by the agreement.

Meanwhile, Eclatant Films claims that its agreement requires Ram Gopal Varma to obtain a prior written No-Objection Certificate (NOC) before associating with third parties or undertaking activities involving movie production, co-production, direction or writing until the outstanding dues are cleared.

Notably, The company has specifically cautioned individuals and entities proposing to acquire, license, distribute, broadcast, stream or otherwise exploit rights connected with projects falling within the scope of the agreement.

As per the latest buzz, It has further warned that parties proceeding with such transactions without the requisite NOC would do so at their own risk. The notice mentions possible legal remedies, including injunctions, recovery proceedings and enforcement of contractual security rights.

title: Abundantia Entertainment, invideo begin production on AI-assisted film Beta Builder, starring Mayur More and Ashlesha Thakur
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The project is part of a collaboration revealed in February 2026, under which invideo committed Rs 100 crore rupees over three years towards a slate of five AI-driven feature films. The partnership brings together Abundantia Entertainment’s production experience and invideo’s generative AI technology.

Adding to this, Beta Builder follows Jai, a self-taught architect from Dharavi who gets an opportunity to pursue his ambitions in the world of virtual reality. As he attempts to establish himself, he must also challenge the system holding him back, fight for the person he loves and ensure that his community has a say in shaping its future.
Meanwhile, The movie explores themes of ambition, belonging and community, bringing together the realities of Dharavi and the possibilities of a virtual world.
Notably, The cast is led by Mayur More, known for Kota Factory and Black, White & Gray: Love Kills , and Ashlesha Thakur, who appeared in The Family Man.

As per the latest buzz, Commenting on the first movie to roll out under the slate, Vikram Malhotra, Founder and CEO, Abundantia Entertainment, shared: “In our partnership with invideo and Sanket, our focus is to leverage AI and tell stories that are unique, impactful and entertaining. I am delighted that the first movie in our slate is one that tells a story set in a relatable, young world and explores aspirational possibilities beyond. And in Hridaye, we have a filmmaker who combines a strong creative vision with a deep command over technology, which makes him the ideal person to lead and bring Beta Builder to life. I am excited about how aiON is enabling unique stories and storytellers to come to the fore and bring their best to followers all over the world.”

In further updates, Sharing his vision for the partnership, Sanket Shah, CEO, invideo, shared: “At InVideo, our mission has always been to put powerful tools in the hands of storytellers. Beta Builder is where that mission takes the form of a full-length movie, made with a partner of Abundantia’s calibre. It is a story about building something that lasts, which makes it the right movie to begin this slate with.”

On top of that, On helming the movie, Hridaye A Nagpal, Global Creative Lead invideo, and Director of Beta Builder , shared: “We are about to see a wave of fascinating films. With AI-assisted filmmaking, storytellers can dream much bigger, and backing a bold idea finally feels possible. The partnership between Abundantia and invideo gives filmmakers the scale and creative support to take on ideas like this. Beta Builder is our bet on that future, with a live-action shoot and AI working side by side.”

title: Ashoke Pandit slams Naseeruddin Shah for backing protesting Jamia students, says actor is exposing his frustration and needs to consult a psychiatrist

title: Ramayana song Judi Jodi sparks debate over Shreya Ghoshal vs Chinmayi Sripaada's versions
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The makers of Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana : Rise of a Legend have rolled out Judi Jodi, a song that takes viewers into the wedding of Lord Rama and Goddess Sita. Featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi, the track was rolled out on Karwa Chauth, a festival that celebrates the bond between married couples. Composed by A.R. Rahman, with lyrics by Dr. Kumar Vishwas, the song is the latest glimpse into the movie's musical world.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi's Ramayana song Judi Jodi celebrates Rama and Sita's wedding, sparks a vocal debate. Judi Jodi celebrates Rama and Sita's wedding The song captures the wedding celebrations of Rama and Sita, including the varmala ceremony. It has been rolled out in five languages: Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam and Kannada. Shreya Ghoshal has sung the Hindi version. Announcing the rollout on social media, the makers wrote, "Celebrate this Karwa Chauth with a love that is eternal and a bond that is divine. Judi Jodi, song out now".

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram Shreya Ghoshal and Chinmayi Sripaada's renditions compared The Hindi version has also sparked a debate over Shreya Ghoshal's studio recording and Chinmayi Sripaada 's live rendition. One user on X felt Chinmayi's performance carried more emotion, writing, “Shreya Ghoshal's Judi Jodi studio version despite being clear somehow lacks the soul and melancholy of Chinmayi Sripada 's live version even though it was unprepared. A testament to importance of texture and simplicity in certain compositions. #ARRahman.”

Notably, Others, however, felt Ghoshal's voice elevated the composition. Praising her performance, another listener wrote, “THERE YOU GO! Shreya Ghoshal just TRANSFORMED this middling composition. It doesn’t always work but she has this innate ability to infuse life into a song with the mere verve of her voice. She has pulled this off for mediocre tunes like Deewani Mastani & Ghoomar too. #Ramayana.”

As per the latest buzz, Some listeners also welcomed the track as a highlight of the movie's soundtrack so far. One X user wrote, “Judi Jodi is probably the first proper song from AR Rahman for Ramayana. Shreya Ghoshal and the Chorus are fantastic here. Finally something worth listening to.”

In further updates, Meanwhile, several followers want the makers to rollout Chinmayi's version officially, too. One listener wrote, “I wish the makers officially rollout @Chinmayi version as well..it was as beautiful as this one.”

On top of that, Chinmayi performed the song after learning it at short notice, but her live rendition found appreciation among some listeners. She later clarified on social media that she had stepped in as a stand-in and credited Shreya as the original singer. She wrote on X, “Judi Jodi is beautifully sung originally by the Goat Shreya Ghoshal. I was a stand in and learned the song literally at the very last minute. I am grateful for the opportunity and to my Guru, Rahman Sir.”

Rahman has spoken about the amount of work that went into creating the soundtrack, explaining that the process of developing and refining the music left him with little time to follow online reactions. In an interview with Hindustan Times, he shared, “We do so much work, filtration, ideation, and iteration that there's no energy left to look at feedback! We just put it out because it's been tried and tested so much. My son keeps telling me, 'This is what they shared yesterday, now they're apologising...' I say fine, I've done my work sincerely and hope people celebrate it."

title: Archana Puran Singh's son Ayushmaan Sethi gets engaged to girlfriend Samiksha Shetty in Italy
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

Archana Puran Singh and Parmeet Sethi’s younger son, Ayushmaan Sethi, is engaged to his girlfriend, Samiksha Shetty. The content creator and YouTuber posted a vlog to document the proposal during their Italian vacation and also posted pictures on their Instagram account.

Adding to this, Ayushman Sethi and Samiksha Shetty shared pictures from the dreamy proposal on Instagram. In the caption of their joint Instagram post, Samiksha wrote, “Of all the places in the world, of all the lives we could’ve lived, somehow we found each other. And we’d choose each other every single time. Here’s to every lifetime together.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Samiksha Shetty (@samikshashetty_)

Notably, Ayushmaan shared a vlog on his YouTube channel, which began by him telling mom Archana, dad Parmeet, and his elder brother Aaryamann Sethi, that he is going to propose in Italy. They all were very excited and wished him all the luck, and the vlog then shifted to their vacation in Italy where Ayushmaan shared how he packed the ring and some flowers in his bag and looked for a beautiful spot to pop the question. He admitted on camera that he felt extremely nervous and his hands were even shaking as he set up the tripod to shoot it on camera.

As per the latest buzz, Ayushmaan then went towards her, told her to turn around and went down on one knee. He then shared how Samiksha came into his life and changed it forever and he cannot wait to spend the rest of his life with her. He shared, “Sam, you make the impossible possible. I always thought that happily ever afters were not for me and that I would never find someone I love that I would spend the rest of my life with.

In further updates, “Then you walked into my life. You walked into those doors at Bombay Dark and you changed my life forever. I never thought that I could love someone so, so much. I thought true love was supposed to be like instantly falling in love with you and knowing that you are the one and feeling all butterflies but this wasn’t that. This was better because the more I got to know you the more I fell in love with you,” he added.

On top of that, Samiksha got emotional and shared yes as he brought out the ring and asked if she would marry him. The two then embraced each other and shared a few minutes in the same spot, admiring the beauty of the place.

Ayushmaan is an aspiring star. He has revealed in vlogs that he ranked among the top 100 students globally in his Class 12 exams and even received an offer from an Ivy League institution. However, he chose to turn it down to follow his passion for acting. Archana has also shared that her son has faced multiple rejections at auditions but continues to persevere. Speaking about his goals, Ayushmaan told Instant Bollywood, “I want to make my parents’ name more famous, and I want to make good movies and do good work. This is my goal.”

title: Filmmaker Amole Gupte says he doesn't fit into Bollywood, feels it's better he is away from it
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Amole Gupte, known for films such as Stanley Ka Dabba, Hawaa Hawaai, and Sniff, says mainstream producers are now reluctant to back sensible stories and that's one of the reasons why he is not able to make films for the big screen.

Adding to this, Amole Gupte has helmed films like Stanley Ka Dabba. The director, who has also acted in movies such as Kaminey, Phas Gaye Re Obama, Singham Returns, shared it has never been easy for him to make his kind of films.

Meanwhile, "The fact that they are not knocking on my door is an indication that they are not willing to back my vision. That's good enough (reason) for me to stay away. Life is okay. I don't fit into Bollywood, and it's better I'm away from it," Gupte told PTI in an interview when asked about why he makes fewer movies.
Notably, "It has always been difficult. It's not like a red carpet for me. It has never been," he shared.

As per the latest buzz, The director recalled the time when filmmaker Karan Johar helped him find a producer for his 2011 acclaimed movie, Stanley Ka Dabba, which was screened at the ongoing Jagran Movie Festival.

In further updates, "Karan came for the music launch of Stanley Ka Dabba. He came unshaven and undyed and shared, 'I've to come straight from the airport, because I've promised Deepa (wife), I am coming to launch the music'. These are the people who kind of held my hand at that time. So that I could make the next and then the next. Otherwise, it's difficult," Gupte shared.

On top of that, The filmmaker also talked about the struggle to make and rollout 2021 biographical sports drama, "Saina", which was based on the life of Indian badminton champion Saina Nehwal. Star Parineeti Chopra played the title role.

"In 2015, Saina became world number one in February. And I shared I want to make a movie on her in May 2015. Finally, it was made and rolled out in 2021. I did nothing else in that period," he shared.

title: Kriti Sanon recreates Inde Navarrette's most disturbing scene from Obsession ahead of uncut version release in Hindi

Meanwhile, The video has received an enthusiastic response from viewers on X, with several praising Kriti’s performance. One user wrote, “that voice modulation, those expressions changing in split seconds, oh DAMNNN she's gonna nail her horror movie. SEATED FOR IT.” Another commented, “oh my god they’re actually doing a great job.” A third viewer was equally impressed, writing, “I don’t think anyone could voice Nikki better than Kriti She’s so versatile, and the way she nailed the acting as well is just amazing!”

Notably, Obsession follows Bear Bailey ( Michael Johnston ), a quiet music store employee who has feelings for his co-worker Nikki ( Inde Navarrette ). While Nikki is outgoing and confident, Bear finds it difficult to tell her how he feels. Things change when he discovers a strange toy called the One Wish Willow at a crystal shop.

As per the latest buzz, The cashier warns him that the toy has brought misery to people who have used it, but Bear chooses to ignore the advice. He snaps the willow and wishes for Nikki to love him more than anything in the world. At first, it seems like his wish has worked. Nikki falls for him and begins giving him all the attention he could have hoped for.

In further updates, But Bear soon discovers that getting what he wants comes at a terrible cost. Nikki’s love becomes overwhelming, and her behaviour turns increasingly disturbing and violent. What starts as a dream relationship soon becomes a nightmare, leaving Bear desperate to find a way to reverse his wish before it is too late.

On top of that, Made on a reported budget of just $750,000 (approximately ₹ 7.5 crore rupees), Obsession has as per reports collected $522 million worldwide, with $263 million coming from the domestic market and $253 million from international territories. Its extraordinary ticket-window performance has made it one of the most profitable films ever made and put director Curry Barker firmly on Hollywood’s radar.

After drawing audiences across the world, including in India, the horror movie is now heading to streaming. The uncut original version, starring Inde Navarrette and Michael Johnston, will premiere on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar on October 30 at 7 pm.

title: PVR INOX sees record Q2 as Indian box office crosses Rs 4,000 crore for FIRST time in a quarter!
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:
PVR INOX reports record Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 2,133 crore rupees, with PAT up 111% and 46.3 million patrons amid strong Indian ticket-window growth.

Adding to this, For Q2 FY27, PVR INOX recorded revenue of Rs 21,327 million, or around Rs 2,133 crore rupees, on an Ind AS 116-adjusted basis. This marked a 17% increase from Rs 18,187 million in the corresponding quarter last year.

Meanwhile, Adjusted EBITDA rose 44% year on year to Rs 4,752 million, with the EBITDA margin improving to 22.3% from 18.1%. Profit after tax from continuing operations increased 111% to Rs 2,733 million, compared with Rs 1,296 million in Q2 FY26.

Notably, The cinema chain welcomed 46.3 million patrons during the quarter, marking a 4% year-on-year increase. Occupancy also improved to 30.4%, compared with 28.7% in the same period last year. Average ticket price rose 14% to Rs 298, while average food and beverage spending per head also increased 14% to Rs 153. Both ticketing and F&B revenues grew 18% during the quarter.
As per the latest buzz, The company shared the results were supported by a strong theatrical slate and increased consumer spending.

In further updates, Commenting on the performance, PVR INOX Managing Director Ajay Bijli shared, “Q2 FY'27 has been a landmark quarter for Indian cinema and PVR INOX. We achieved record quarterly and half-yearly revenue, EBITDA and PAT, supported by strong content, higher consumer spends and disciplined costs.”

On top of that, He added, “Our margins are now well above pre-COVID levels, a clear sign of a structurally stronger business. We generated significant free cash flow, completed our maiden share buyback and carry a strong balance sheet.”

PVR INOX's results come amid a strong quarter for the Indian theatrical market. According to Ormax Media and company estimates cited by PVR INOX, India's gross ticket-window collections reached Rs 4,443 crore rupees in Q2 FY27, representing 23% year-on-year growth.

The director has shared that the third instalment of his hit romantic drama Tanu Weds Manu will not move ahead without its original leading actors, R Madhavan and Kangana Ranaut .

Adding to this, Tanu Weds Manu was rolled out in 2011. Aanand L Rai on Tanu Weds Manu 3 Aanand directed the first two films in the romantic-comedy franchise in 2011 and 2015. title: Netflix's Ruchikaa Kapoor Sheikh explains why polarising conversations are a better success metric than viewership numbers, top 10 lists | Interview
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

It has been a curious year for Netflix in India. The streaming platform has delivered some much-talked-about films, which have remained in public discourse for weeks after rollout. On the flip side, there are films that have grabbed the attention of the viewers immediately, like theatrical releases do. As the year winds down, we sit down to chat with Ruchikaa Kapoor Sheikh, Director, Original Films, Netflix India, on how 2026 was for films on Netflix and the idea of ‘success’ on streaming.

Adding to this, Ruchikaa Kapoor Sheikh discusses 2026 for films on Netflix and more. ‘The lead-up to rollout doesn't have to be rife’ ‘Surprising’ is the word that Ruchikaa uses to describe the year that Netflix films have had. “Every year, there's been one or two breakout titles that have really carried that conversation forward. I feel this year was surprising because, across the board, different films found success in their own right, which I haven't seen happen in a long time. Whether it was Accused, a small movie that travelled to 72 countries or Toaster, which was number one on the global top 10,” she says.

Meanwhile, Ruchikaa believes that streaming and the social media boom have changed how films ought to be promoted, at least a certain kind of movie. “Those days of promoting early on, creating a buzz are gone,” she says. “The lead-up to a movie doesn't have to be rife, given today's explosion of information. And we are so used to reading something today and then watching it immediately. That absolute call to action exists. There was a time when creating anticipation and excitement, and coming, were needed. And we’d have releases about they have started shooting, and they met outside this office. But, I think the audience can actually see through that today.”

Notably, It is often shared that streaming was a clutter-breaker for Indian cinema, as the films on OTT platforms broke the formulaic approach to filmmaking. Ruchikaa agrees, “Anything that feels formulaic has always been scary. I've handled theatrical (releases) for 12 years of my life. There would be proper formulaic films. And I used to be most scared. Because they would say, ‘Yeh to chal hi jaayegi (This will work for sure)’.”

As per the latest buzz, She agrees the industry has misunderstood what the audience wants, which is what gave rise to the formula. “When the audience really likes something, we say, ‘Let's give them some more of it’. Suddenly, what worked for something, you take that mould, and you make it a template, and it actually stops working. When we did Sector 36, we (were pitched) 20 true crime stories. But we've just done this, so this is exactly what we'll not do. The audience genuinely has shown us that they are ready. They say when you're ready to give us something new, and when you're taking those creative swings and risks, we are showing up,” she says.

In further updates, The years in India have helped Netflix understand what ‘success’ truly means for a movie away from the ticket-window. Ruchikaa says that while viewership figures and a place on global top lists are important, they aren’t everything. “Early on, it is important for me to see how many people are coming to it because I think that gives me a sense of whether we have been able to connect to people. But in the long term, I don't think it's ever going to be how many people have come and watched. Being in the global top 10 is incredible, and it is an important success metric. But for me, really, it is the conversation that sparks.”

On top of that, Ruchikaa says the conversations, especially the ones that are polarising, are what truly determine a movie’s success today. She explains, “When people watched Maa-Behen, there was a section that shared, ‘I feel represented.’ And then another section shared, "Ye kya tha? Auratein ye kya kar rahi hain?" And for me, both are very important conversations, because there are certain films that actually appeal to polarising conversations, and we encourage them because that is really how we find ourselves in the centre of the zeitgeist. So when a movie lives with you far after, when there are characters that you'll remember, when there are mannerisms you'll do, it means that something of that has stayed in you, and that truly is the measure of success for a movie for me.”

title: Varun Dhawan wants Sidharth Malhotra for a Heated Rivalry remake, says there was tension in Student of the Year
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Varun Dhawan has a pick for a Bollywood version of Heated Rivalry , and it is none other than his Student of the Year co-star Sidharth Malhotra . The star made the suggestion on Karan Johar’s Koffee With Karan Season 9, joking that the two had the kind of tension that could have taken their 2012 movie in a very different direction. Varun Dhawan and Janhvi Kapoor were the guests on the third episode of the final season, along with Arjun Kapoor as special guest.

Adding to this, Varun Dhawan has a pick for a Bollywood version of Heated Rivalry, and it is none other than his Student of the Year co-star Sidharth Malhotra. Varun says followers wanted him and Sidharth to end up together The conversation came up during the rapid-fire round of an episode featuring Varun and Janhvi, with Arjun joining them on the couch midway. When Karan asked Varun which male co-star he would choose for a remake of the Canadian romance series, he was quick with his answer: “Sidharth Malhotra”.

Meanwhile, Karan, who launched both actors in Student of the Year, seemed to approve of the idea, calling the pairing “quite sexy”. Varun then explained why he thought it could work, bringing up the movie that first introduced him and Sidharth to audiences. He pointed out that their characters already had a certain dynamic in Student of the Year. “I think there was (sexual) tension (between them) even in SOTY,” he shared, adding, “Lot of people were, me and Sid should end up together more than Alia”.

Notably, The remark left Arjun wondering whether he had missed an alternate version of the 2012 movie. He asked if Student of the Year actually had such an ending, prompting Varun to insist that it did. Arjun then joked that the version Varun was talking about existed only in his imagination. In Student of the Year, Varun and Sidharth played students who find themselves competing against each other, with Alia Bhatt’s character caught up in the rivalry.

As per the latest buzz, The internet wasted no time reacting to Varun’s confession. Since the episode dropped, the clip has been doing the rounds on social media, particularly on X (formerly Twitter), where one post featuring the exchange has racked up nearly a million views. Followers have also been sharing edits of Rohan and Abhimanyu from Student of the Year, highlighting the tension between their characters and imagining what their dynamic might have looked like as a romance.

In further updates, Heated Rivalry centres on Shane Hollander and Ilya Rozanov, two professional hockey players whose rivalry on the ice slowly turns into a romance they keep hidden from the world. Adapted from Rachel Reid’s Game Changers novels, the Canadian series follows their relationship over a decade as they struggle to balance their feelings for each other with their careers and the pressure of being public figures.

On top of that, Hudson Williams and Connor Storrie play the two hockey stars, and the series has become a massive hit, turning both actors into breakout stars and bringing them a level of fame that has grown well beyond the show. Heated Rivalry premiered in India on Lionsgate Play in February 2026 in English and Hindi. With the series finding a huge global audience, the actors are now filming the second season, which is scheduled to rollout in 2027.

Varun is as per reports in talks to star in Yash Raj Films' first-ever horror feature movie, directed by Abhay Pannu. A source close to the project told Hindustan Times earlier this year, “Varun has come on board as the lead for YRF’s first horror movie. title: Anupam Kher says he feels proud to see the reactions to Ramayana after its LA premiere; praises Namit Malhotra, Nitesh Tiwari and Ranbir Kapoor
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

All eyes are on Ramayana as it gears up for rollout in a few days. Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi, Yash and director Nitesh Tiwari attended the Los Angeles premiere of Ramayana at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles. Following the grand premiere, the first reactions to the ambitious adaptation of the Indian epic surfaced on social media where many lauded its scale, visuals and performances, with comparisons being made to The Lord of the Rings.

Adding to this, Anupam Kher is awaiting the rollout of Ramayana. What Anupam Kher shared Now, veteran star Anupam Kher, who has voiced the vulture demigod Jatayu in the movie, has shared a note after the movie's premiere in LA. Anupam shared a video on X, saying he is really happy to see the reactions to Ramayana after the world premiere in Los Angeles. He added that the audience can see the grandeur and visuals, and that it is a moment of pride that an epic of India has been presented on this scale internationally. He lauded the combined effort of producer Namit Malhotra, director Nitesh Tiwari, music composers Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman and the entire cast and crew for their immense hard work in making Ramayana.

Meanwhile, He added, “People are also noticing the amazing creation of Jatayu in the movie, and it gives me so much pleasure to tell you that I have voiced that part. Actually, to see how Indian talent and Indian films are getting lauded outside the country gives me a lot of satisfaction. Thank you to the creators in Ramayana for taking the movie to such a grand scale. Go watch the movie when it releases in theatres on November 5.”

Notably, In the caption, he wrote in Hindi, “The early reactions to Ramayana coming in from Los Angeles are filling my heart with immense joy and pride. Seeing our great epic reach audiences around the world on such a grand scale is an incredible feeling. And in this journey, getting to voice Jatayu is especially meaningful to me. I'm eagerly looking forward to watching the movie in Stockholm on November 5. Jai Ho!”

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the ancient Indian epic. Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi portrays Sita, and Yash plays Ravana. The cast also includes Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. The movie is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, with music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer.

In further updates, As per reports mounted on a budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees, the movie is backed by Yash and Namit Malhotra and is planned as a two-part franchise. The first instalment is scheduled to rollout in theatres on November 5, 2026, with the second part expected to arrive around Diwali 2027.

title: Janhvi Kapoor finally confirms she is dating Shikhar Pahariya, reveals marriage plans on Koffee With Karan

Janhvi Kapoor on marriage plans with Shikhar Pahariya In the latest episode of Koffee With Karan, when Karan Johar asked Janhvi whether she was officially dating Shikhar, she verified it and added, "I always thought about why everyone is so cagey about it. title: Kunal Kapoor, who plays Indra Dev in Ramayana, says one of the biggest things holding India back is ‘our fear of failure’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Kunal Kapoor is gearing up for the rollout of Ramayana , where he plays Indra Dev. The star takes to his X account to often share candid thoughts and opinions on a variety of topics. He talks about the films he liked and the latest events in the country and interacts with users on the platform. On Thursday, the star shared a long note about how one of the biggest things that is holding India back is the fear of failure.

Adding to this, Kunal Kapoor spoke about the need to take risks and how one must not be afraid to fail. Kunal speaks on the shame attached to failure In his note, Kunal shared, “I think one of the biggest things holding India back is our fear of failure. We’re taught to fear it from the time we’re young. Students are pushed to breaking point because failing an exam feels like the end of the world. We stay in marriages everyone knows aren’t working because leaving feels like failure. People stay in jobs they hate because they’re terrified they won’t find another one. We’ve built a society where the shame of failing often feels worse than the cost of staying stuck.”

Meanwhile, The star then went on to add how this is a generational issue and cannot be cured so easily. He wrote, “And to be fair to us, it comes from generations of scarcity. Too many people, too few opportunities. When survival is the priority, taking risks feels like a luxury. But you cannot build a great country if its people are terrified of getting things wrong. We don’t just need more ambition. We need to become a country where failure isn’t a life sentence. And maybe that’s starts small, with how we react to our kids or people around us, when they fail.”

Notably, Kunal did not specifically point out any particular project or name anyone to share why he spoke about failure. When a fan commented, “Spoken like a true king, Lord Indra,” the star acknowledged the comment with folded hands emoticons.

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Yash as Ravana. The ensemble cast also includes Lara Dutta, Sunny Deol, Ravi Dubey, Sheeba Chaddha, and Arun Govil in key roles. The movie is slated for a two-part rollout, with the first part hitting cinemas on Diwali 2026 and the second in 2027.

In further updates, Earlier in an interview with News18, Kunal had spoken the large scale on which the movie is made and shared, “This is a very important movie in our cultural history. It’s a really important part of our cultural ethos. I think it’s important that we have filmmakers and teams who can give it the kind of scale it needs. This is mounted at a scale that we’ve never seen before.”

title: Tamannaah Bhatia is unbothered by Annu Kapoor's ‘misogynist’ remark on her complexion, says she's focused on work
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Veteran star Annu Kapoor faced criticism last year for his comments on Tamannaah Bhatia 's complexion and appearance during a podcast, with his remarks being labelled misogynistic and sexist. Speaking at NDTV Profit Ignite, Tamannaah has now opened up that she was unbothered by his comments and remains focused on her work.

Adding to this, Tamannaah Bhatia reacts to Annu Kapoor's remark on her complexion. Tamannaah Bhatia replies to Annu Kapoor's remark When asked about the remarks on her complexion, which drew criticism for being misogynistic and sexist, Tamannaah was also asked whether her movie choices were part of an image makeover aimed at changing how audiences perceive her at this stage of her career, beyond her image as an star known for her screen presence and sensuality. She shared she was unbothered by the comments.

Meanwhile, She shared, "I think that as a creative person, our most important task is to listen. And when we listen, what we keep and what we filter is very important to understand. And because you are also a woman, you can understand that if we start giving importance to such things, then perhaps we will not be able to move forward in life."

Notably, She added, "So I don't even see these things. I focus on my work. I focus on what I want to make. I focus on my acting career. And genuinely, according to me, I want to do my work like a service. And I do that. And maybe that's why it reaches people, because somewhere it comes from the right place."

As per the latest buzz, Last year, Annu appeared on Shubhankar Mishra's YouTube channel and spoke about watching a clip of the song Aaj Ki Raat. The host then asked him whether he liked the song and mentioned that he admired Tamannaah. In response, Annu shared, "Mashallah kya dudhiya badan hai (Mashallah, what a fair and beautiful body)."

In further updates, Annu went on to say, "Behen, apne gaane se, aapne shareer se, apne dudhiya chehre se humare bacchon ko sulaati hain... Bahut achi baat hai.. Desh ke upar kripa hogi agar humare desh ke bacch achi aur swasth neend soyein. Agar aur bhi kuch ichcha hain toh bhagwan unko samarth karre ke unki ichcha puri hun (Our sister is making kids sleep with her song, with her milky face and body, if she is making our children sleep sweetly, it's very good, man... It will be a great blessing for this country that our children get a good and healthy night's sleep. If she has any other wishes, may God give her the capability to fulfil her wishes. That's my blessing for her)."

On top of that, Tamannaah was last seen in Vvaan: Force of the Forest, which also featured Sidharth Malhotra in a lead role. She will next be seen in Balaji Motion Pictures' Ragini MMS 3. The movie also stars Junaid Khan in a lead role and is scheduled for rollout in 2027.

title: Varun Dhawan regrets his ‘8 hits in a row’ boast against Ranbir Kapoor, Ranveer Singh on Koffee With Karan, says he jinxed his success
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Varun Dhawan once boasted about his successful films while addressing comparisons with Ranveer Singh and Ranbir Kapoor on Koffee With Karan Season 6. During his recent appearance on Koffee With Karan Season 9, the star admitted that he regretted the boast and expressed his desire to emulate Ajay Devgn.

Adding to this, Varun Dhawan says he shouldn't have flexed about his success. Varun Dhawan regrets flexing his success on Koffee With Karan 9 When Karan Johar spoke about Varun becoming a “meme factory” because of his smile, Varun shared that it was Karan who had started it. He further explained that the smile meme originated from a scene in Student of the Year. He added, “I think the whole thing of these things happening, whether it was a push narrative or not a push narrative, what I have realised over the time, after maturing, is that the only flex one should do is with your work. Like, I feel many years back, I came here and flexed about how many hits I had, and eventually, it jinxed me.”

Meanwhile, Karan then brought up Varun’s earlier statement about Ranbir and Ranveer. During Koffee With Karan Season 6, when Karan asked Varun who he considered a bigger competitor, Ranbir or Ranveer, Varun replied, “No one. they haven't had what I've had. I've had eight hits in a row.”

Notably, Varun and Janhvi Kapoor then pointed out that Varun had had 11 hits by that point, but he was quick to clarify that he did not want it to look like another boast. He added, “I don't want to flex or anything in that matter because I just feel that when you are having success or something becomes success, I think it is something better to be like Ajay Devgn. He doesn't react. He is that one guy I have seen through success or through failure; he looks at you the same way. It's amazing.”

As per the latest buzz, Varun was most of late seen in David Dhawan's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, which collected only ₹ 74.83 crore rupees worldwide at the ticket-window and received negative reviews. title: Sharvari dances with OG Rajshri heroine Madhuri Dixit to Yeh Prem Mol Liya song, calls it a ‘surreal’ moment with her idol
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Sharvari got to live a fan moment she will remember for a long time. The star of late danced with Madhuri Dixit to the title track of her soon-to-release movie, Yeh Prem Mol Liya , and shared a video of their meeting on Instagram. The movie stars Ayushmann Khurrana opposite Sharvari and is helmed by Sooraj Barjatya.

Adding to this, Sharvari calls Madhuri Dixit an OG Rajshri heroine. Sharvari calls Madhuri Dixit her idol In the video, Sharvari begins dancing to the song before Madhuri joins her. The two share a few steps, and the clip ends with Sharvari bowing to the veteran star before the two hug. The sweet interaction brings together two generations of actors connected to the Rajshri banner.

Meanwhile, Sharvari shared her excitement in the caption, thanking Madhuri for the warmth and affection she showed her. She also referred to the star as one of the original Rajshri heroines, recalling the legacy of the films she has been part of. Sharvari wrote, “So honoured to receive this much prem from one of the OG Rajshri heroines of Sooraj Barjatya sir.. the one and only Madhuri Dixit ma’am ♥️✨ Getting to dance alongside my idol feels surreal and soooo special 🥹😭♥️ Thankyou ma’am, you are the best! Hum Aapke Hain Kaun 🤝 #YehPremMolLiya In theatres 27th Nov 2026.”

Notably, View this post on Instagram Madhuri’s association with Sooraj Barjatya goes back to Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!, the 1994 smash hit that became known for its songs, family celebrations and memorable performances. The movie was led by her and Salman Khan along with Mohnish Bahl and Renuka Shahane in pivotal roles.

As per the latest buzz, The dance video comes as the makers build excitement around the movie’s music. Earlier this month, they rolled out Jhumka Patola, a pre-wedding song sung by Shreya Ghoshal and composed by Himesh Reshammiya.

In further updates, The star opened up about her experience filming Jhumka Patola and how the director helped her connect with her character through the music. She shared, “I’ve always loved dancing, but with Sooraj sir, a song is so deeply woven into the narrative that you can’t look at it as just a dance performance. While shooting ‘Jhumka Patola’, he would walk me through what the moment meant for my character and share stories from the songs he has made over the years, and I tried to carry that into every step and expression. Dance has its own language, and sometimes a song can say what a scene simply cannot.”

On top of that, Yeh Prem Mol Liya is produced by Rajshri Productions in association with Mahaveer Jain Films. The movie also features Anupam Kher, Supriya Pathak, Seema Pahwa and Saumya Tandon. It is scheduled to rollout in theatres on November 27, 2026.

title: Digital world isolates people, cinema offers collective experience, says Imtiaz Ali
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Mumbai, Filmmaker Imtiaz Ali believes the growing consumption of digital content has made people more isolated, while the big screen offers a shared emotional experience.

Adding to this, Digital world isolates people, cinema offers collective experience, says Imtiaz Ali "Post COVID, the viewing habits have changed. Today, people watch a lot more ... So, things have changed big time in the industry. Today, we're watching ten times more content in different forms, be it reels, stories, etc. But these things are often watched in isolation, either on a phone or on some other device, when you're alone," Ali shared last evening on day one of a movie festival here.
Meanwhile, The filmmaker shared the theatrical experience remains valuable because cinema allows people to share their reactions and emotions with others.

Notably, "When I'm experiencing something, like an emotion, and the people around me are experiencing the same thing, it gives a very beautiful feeling because humans were not created to live isolated from everyone," he shared.

As per the latest buzz, "However, the disadvantage of the digital world is that it isolates people, whereas the advantage of theatre is that it gives people a collective experience. I don't have a secret formula to give as to how a movie works but I hope films work in theatres and that people go to theatres to watch a movie. Like, it happened in case of 'Main Vaapas Aaunga'," Ali added.

In further updates, The director reflected on the response to his last movie, "Main Vaapas Aaunga", and shared achieving both critical appreciation and commercial success was a matter of good fortune.

On top of that, "The lesson that we got from this was that there should be a direct interaction between a filmmaker and audience, every filmmaker and artist should be connected to people, then they will know what more can they do in their respective field. Otherwise, we are taking a shot in the dark, and that's why our work sometimes does not hit the mark," Ali shared.
Asked about his next movie, the director shared he is currently writing a story and doesn't have actors in mind.

title: After SRFTI, Naseeruddin Shah shares video backing Jamia Millia Islamia students, says he is a 'proud dimagi Naxal'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After lending support to the students of the Satyajit Ray Movie and Television Institute (SRFTI), star Naseeruddin Shah has now come out in support of Jamia Millia Islamia students, who have been protesting for the restoration of their union.

Adding to this, Naseeruddin Shah has backed the protesting Jamia Millia Islamia students. Naseeruddin Shah backs Jamia students The multiple National Award winner shared a video on social media on Wednesday, slamming the central government for their reaction to the Jamia students' protests, and accused the BJP -led administration of trying to destroy the education system and break the "courage of the country's youth".

Meanwhile, In the video, the star appeared wearing a ‘Dimagi Naxal’ pin, showing it to the camera. The term was used by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in a speech earlier this year for critics of the administration.

Notably, "I proudly declare that I am Dimagi Naxal. I don't know what other nicknames the watchmen have given to people like me, anti-national, 'tukde tukde' gang, and I don't know what else," Naseeruddin Shah shared in Hindi.

As per the latest buzz, In the video, posted on Facebook, Naseer added, “I want to ask this government a question. What else will you do to break the courage of our country's youth, to destroy the education system, and to put our democracy at risk? How much will you do? How far will you go?”

In further updates, The 76-year-old star has been posting frequent videos and has been vocal in his support for student-related issues. He earlier criticised the government for its handling of the Cockroach Janata Party-led protest over NEET exam irregularities in July.
On top of that, The protesting students have demanded a definite date for the polls, which have not been held since 2006, and a clear timeline for the approval of the student union's constitution.

As protests at the Jamia Millia Islamia entered their 15th day on Monday, the administration agreed to one of the students' key demands, announcing it would resume student union elections after two decades. However, this failed to resolve the stand-off with students saying the administration had not issued a definite timeline for the polls.
