title: Priyanka Chopra's DIY mehendi for husband Nick Jonas on Karwa Chauth has a special touch for daughter Malti Marie
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Every year, as married Indian women celebrate Karwa Chauth, applying mehendi to their palms becomes an integral part of the festivities. Star Priyanka Chopra continues to embrace her Indian traditions and has now offered a glimpse of her Karwa Chauth celebrations. This year, her DIY mehendi design was not just about her husband, Nick Jonas, but also featured a special tribute to their daughter, Malti Marie Chopra Jonas.

Adding to this, Priyanka Chopra sends Karwa Chauth wishes to followers. Priyanka Chopra's mehendi for Karwa Chauth On Thursday, Priyanka posted on Instagram to share pictures of her mehendi design, which she applied herself. The star incorporated the initials of both Nick and Malti into the design, adding a personal touch to the occasion. Sharing the pictures, she wrote, "DIY..Piya ke naam ki (in the name of my husband).. happy karwachauth to all those celebrating."

Meanwhile, In another picture, she offered a glimpse of herself applying chashni (sugar syrup) to her mehendi and wrote, "The question is will the chashni work? IYKYK." Many Indian women follow this practice to help their mehendi develop a darker colour. Priyanka's celebrations offered a glimpse of how she continues to observe the traditions associated with the festival while living away from India.

Notably, Earlier, during an appearance on The Kapil Sharma Show in 2025, Priyanka recalled a romantic gesture Nick made for her during Karwa Chauth that set relationship goals. She shared, "We’ve tried to spot the moon in the strangest places. Once, we were at a stadium where he was doing a show, and the moon just wouldn’t appear. There were clouds, and rain was about to start. Around 60–70 thousand people were present and the show kept going on. We waited till 10 pm, then 11 pm, and still the moon wasn’t visible."

As per the latest buzz, She added, "Want to hear something romantic? He finally took me up in a plane, above the clouds, and then I broke my fast after seeing the moon." Her revelation left the audience in awe, while followers on the internet could not stop gushing about the romantic gesture.

In further updates, The couple first met at the 2017 Met Gala, where they walked the red carpet together, representing Ralph Lauren. However, their romance blossomed only the following year, when they began dating. Nick proposed to Priyanka in July 2018, on her birthday, and the couple got married in December that year in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, in Christian and Hindu wedding ceremonies.

On top of that, In January 2022, Priyanka and Nick welcomed their daughter, Malti Marie Chopra Jonas, via surrogacy. Malti was born prematurely and spent more than three months in a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) before she could go home with her parents.

Priyanka will soon make her comeback to Indian cinema with SS Rajamouli's Varanasi. The movie also stars Mahesh Babu and Prithviraj Sukumaran in lead roles and is shared to be one of the most ambitious projects in Indian cinema, mounted on a massive budget of ₹ 1,000 crore rupees. The movie is scheduled to rollout in theatres in April 2027.

title: Sai Pallavi says she wants a life partner who is not self-centered, owns up to his mistakes and knows how to cook
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

All eyes are on Sai Pallavi as she gears up for the rollout for the highly anticipated Ramayana Part 1, which sees her Goddess Sita. The star has been busy promoting the movie, and of late was seen on Kaun Banega Crorepati 18, along with co-stars Ranbir Kapoor and Ravie Dubey. During the episode, host Amitabh Bachchan asked her about the qualities in a man she would want to be in her life partner.

Adding to this, Sai Pallavi at the Los Angeles premiere of Ramayana at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles on October 27, 2026. (Photo by VALERIE MACON / AFP) (AFP) What Sai Pallavi shared In response, Sai shared, “Pehle achche insaan hone chahiye (Firstly he should be a good man). He should not be very self-centred. He should be someone who is introspective. One who checks on his actions. So someone who has some insight about where he is in life… he can make mistakes but he must mend it too. It should not be that he is blaming it on someone else. It is not that there is a huge list but he should be a good person and it would be better if he also knows how to cook!”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sony LIV (@sonylivindia)

Notably, In the episode, Amitabh also asked Sai about her decision to pursue acting after studying medicine. She replied, “God wrote it that you act,” suggesting that she was destined to become an star. Her response left the host perplexed, prompting Ranbir to add a humorous twist to her explanation. “Bhagwan ka prescription tha Sir (God wrote in his prescription) that she has to act,” he shared, drawing cheers and applause from the audience.

As per the latest buzz, In another promo, Sai opened up about her initial reaction when she was offered the role of Sita in Ramayana. She shared, “I didn’t want to use my head this time. Every time when I play a character, I think, 'What can I give to that character? ' but this was the first time when I thought, 'What can I get for playing a role like that of Sita Maa? Like what knowledge will I gain from this?' So, I wanted to keep the process transparent. I didn’t want to think about anything. I prayed to Sita Maa and went forward with it.”

In further updates, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari , the mythological epic stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ravie Dubey as Lakshmana, Yash as Ravana and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The cast also includes Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Kajal Aggarwal and Vivek Oberoi in key roles.

On top of that, As per reports mounted on a budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees, the movie is backed by Yash and Namit Malhotra and is planned as a two-part franchise. The first instalment is scheduled to rollout in theatres on November 5, 2026, with the second part expected to arrive around Diwali 2027.

title: Anurag Kashyap made Gangs of Wasseypur sets feel like a playground, never flaunted authority: Short film Aakhiri Ride makers
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Writer-director and VFX supervisors Yashoda Parthasarthy and Vijesh Rajan began their journeys in the movie industry with Anurag Kashyap . While Vijesh was part of the team behind Gangs of Wasseypur , Yashoda worked with the filmmaker on Raman Raghav 20. Their latest short movie, Aakhiri Ride, is also presented by Anurag and Vasan Bala .

Adding to this, Aakhri Ride makers Yashoda Parthasarthy and Vijesh Rajan spoke about starting their careers with Anurag Kashyap. In an exclusive interaction with Hindustan Times, the duo spoke about how Anurag's early influence shaped their understanding of cinema. They also discussed casting Panchayat star Chandan Roy and featuring the voice of fellow Panchayat star Faisal Malik in their short movie, as well as how their observations during long cab rides across Mumbai inspired Aakhiri Ride.

Meanwhile, Yashoda: While writing Scam Raju's (Faisal Malik) character, I could just hear Faizal Bhai's voice. We have a working relationship with him for many years now. When we approached him, he agreed, and he really loved the script as well.

Notably, Chandan's story is quite unique because when I first made my mom read the script, she recommended him, but I didn't believe that an star from Panchayat-like big show will star in my short movie. We had narrated it to a couple of actors, but we felt like something was missing, and also they were not from UP or Bihar. We wanted someone who looks very dedicated to his work and has a little bit of innocence. Later, our casting team also recommended Chandan, and as soon as he came into the meeting room, we were like, 'Wow, he is perfect'. He is so humble, intelligent, and technically very sound. He's also very dedicated; he would often be like, 'Can I say this line again?' He is very layered as a person, which was quite fun to explore during the process.

As per the latest buzz, Vijesh: It was actually also our way to pay homage to Hindi 90s cinema tropes — a truthful hero whose sister is getting married, a 90s plot where the cop comes at the end, a villain who pops up. We wanted to do our own take on that.

In further updates, Vijesh/Yashoda: A lot of drivers come from UP and Bihar to work in metro cities. Yashoda and I often travel long distances across Mumbai by cab, and that's when we started noticing the drivers and hearing about their problems. So, the movie is somewhat based on several real-life incidents.

On top of that, I remember one particular driver who was in a state of panic, making multiple calls. We couldn't fully understand what he was saying because of the dialect, but he clearly needed to arrange money urgently. Yashoda and I spoke about the tragedy of that situation — both of us sitting comfortably in the back seat, being driven home by someone who might not even have a home to go to, someone who was struggling to make ends meet and suddenly had to arrange money for a payment. That became our starting point for figuring out how to tell this story.

Yashoda: Personally, what I learned from him is that he encourages you to have your own voice. He has a strong creative vision, but he gives you the space to bring your own perspective. He is not selfish. He believes the industry needs to grow. If there are 20 good filmmakers, there will be 20 great films, more opportunities, and audiences will have better choices. We will spoil everyone. Making space for other artists is his philosophy, and I love it.

title: Udta Teer box office collection day 6: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan's spy comedy sees no growth, crosses ₹28 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Udta Teer ticket-window earnings day 6 : Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan's quirky take on the genre of a spy movie, Udta Teer, was rolled out in theatres last Friday. The movie received positive reviews and showed strength at the ticket-window amid recent releases like Nayyi Navelli and Prahaar.

Adding to this, Udta Teer ticket-window earnings day 6: Ayushmann Khurrana plays a Pakistani spy in the movie. Udta Teer ticket-window update Udta Teer leveled up above expectations and collected ₹ 4.10 crore rupees on its opening day in theatres. It opened to decent reviews, which helped its cause and the movie gradually showed growth on Saturday to collect ₹ 7.25 crore rupees. Sunday showed more growth, at ₹ 8.20 crore rupees. It is the highest single-day haul of the movie so far. However, the dip started from Monday, as the movie collected ₹ 3.20 crore rupees.

Meanwhile, As per the latest update on Sacnilk, Udta Teer has managed to collect ₹ 2.65 crore rupees on Wednesday. This brings the total India collection to ₹ 28.65 crore rupees . The movie has to remain steady in the soon-to-release days, before the big rollout this Diwali in the form of Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana .

Notably, Taran Adarsh also pointed at the ticket-window performance of Udta Teer and wrote on X, “Udta Teer remains on par with Monday on Tuesday, with the discounted ticket offer boosting footfalls... The #BOGO ticket offer today [Wednesday] should help the numbers remain stable. The *Week 1* total is expected to be around ₹ 31 cr [+/-] – a fair result... The movie has one more week to make the most of its theatrical run, starting this Friday, before #Ramayana arrives next Thursday [5 Nov].”

As per the latest buzz, The movie follows a Pakistani spy, played by Khurrana, who loses his memory after a blast and begins to believe that he is an Indian Counter-Terrorism Squad officer. His mistaken identity sets off a chain of comic and action-packed events as he becomes caught up in a cross-border espionage operation.

In further updates, It also stars Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Suhail Nayyar, Gulshan Grover, late Mukul Dev, Raghubir Yadav, Brijendra Kala, Supriya Pilgaonkar and Sandeep Anand in supporting roles. The project marks the fourth collaboration between Karan Johar's Dharma Productions and Guneet Monga-led Sikhya Entertainment after The Lunchbox, Kill and Gyaarah Gyaarah.

title: Janhvi Kapoor says she should have been more vigilant about the objectification in Peddi, admits the role propagated sexual assualt in the narrative
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Buchi Babu Sana's sports action drama, Peddi, rolled out in theatres on June 4. The movie faced criticism from a section of viewers over the hypersexualisation of Janhvi Kapoor 's character. Later, director Buchi Babu Sana took to X (formerly Twitter) to issue an apology for the star’s portrayal in the movie and changes were made. Now, months later, Janhvi has opened up about the entire backlash surrounding the movie and her character during her appearance on the chat show Koffee with Karan .

Adding to this, Janhvi Kapoor in a still from Peddi. What Janhvi shared When host Karan Johar asked her about how she processed the entire issue, Janhvi shared, “I feel many people worked really hard on that movie and I really didn't know if there was anything to say. It weighs heavily on my conscience the sort of negative impact a narrative like that can have our society. Specific to my gender. That shame I will always carry with me. Could I have done more? Could I have been more vigilant? 100% yes. Was it problematic, was it extreme objectification? Did it even propagate sexual assault narratively? Yes. But the only thing I can do is ensure that it doesn't happen again.”

Meanwhile, She went on to add, “I went through the beats of really beating up myself that I should have been more vigilant. I don't like saying this because it sounds like i am shifting blame but its like you listen to the director and what he says. I was navigating how to make things less problematic as and when information was becoming available to me. In the south, very rarely there is a bound script. very rarely do u see the camera angles. I should have taken advantage of my privilege. It was a violating experience in a way. the good thing that came out of it is that maybe next time a director will rethink twice before presenting a lead star this way.”

Notably, Peddi is a sports drama in which Ram plays the titular character. Janhvi plays Achiyamma, Peddi’s love interest. Since the movie's rollout, viewers have criticised the way Janhvi's character, Achiyyamma, is introduced on screen. Many pointed to sequences that focus heavily on her body rather than establishing her as a character. Another scene that came under scrutiny involves Peddi expressing his desire to be with Achiyyamma despite her lack of interest and later kissing her during a power cut without her consent.

As per the latest buzz, Following the backlash, director Buchi Babu Sana issued an apology on X and acknowledged the concerns raised by audiences. A part of his statement read, "I have always had immense respect for women, both on and off screen, and it was never our intention to objectify or disrespect any female character. If any part of the movie has been perceived that way, we respect those sentiments, understand the concerns being raised, and sincerely apologise. After reviewing the feedback, we have decided to make changes to the concerned portions."

title: Could Yash’s Ravana steal the thunder from Ranbir Kapoor’s Lord Ram? The STAR POWER battle inside Ramayana
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

But beyond its scale and technological ambition, the movie presents a fascinating star-power experiment. Can Yash, who became a pan-Indian phenomenon through KGF , attract as much attention as Ranbir Kapoor, the star playing the central protagonist?

Adding to this, The question isn’t about which character is more important to the story. Lord Rama is the moral and narrative centre of the epic, while Ravana represents its formidable opposition. Rather, it concerns an interesting phenomenon in commercial cinema. Audiences are often fascinated by a larger-than-life antagonist.

Meanwhile, Hindi cinema has a long history of memorable villains. Gabbar Singh, Mogambo and several other iconic antagonists continue to occupy an extraordinary place in popular culture. In more recent years, major action films have relied increasingly on powerful adversaries whose personalities, appearances and dramatic entrances become central attractions. Yash’s casting brings another dimension to this tradition.

Notably, Through KGF , the Kannada superstar demonstrated that an star could transcend linguistic boundaries and become popular across the country. Rocky Bhai’s appeal rested on his attitude, dialogue delivery, visual presentation and larger-than-life personality. Now Yash is stepping into an altogether different universe.

As per the latest buzz, Ravana is not a conventional action-movie villain. He is a complex mythological figure traditionally depicted as immensely powerful, knowledgeable and accomplished, but ultimately brought down by his own choices. For Yash, this offers an opportunity to create a character that combines physical presence with dramatic complexity.

In further updates, In that sense, Ramayana represents two contrasting forms of stardom. Yash’s existing mass appeal could be well suited to Ravana’s imposing personality. Ranbir’s strength as an star lies in his ability to communicate vulnerability, internal conflict and emotion. If the movie is successful, audiences could be drawn to both for different reasons.

On top of that, There is also the geographical dimension. Ranbir is an established Hindi movie star with major domestic successes, including Sanju , Brahmastra and Animal . Yash, on the other hand, enjoys an especially strong identity in the Kannada market and has demonstrated considerable appeal beyond it.
By bringing them together, the makers have created an opportunity to attract Hindi speaking viewers, South Indian audiences and overseas moviegoers through a single project.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Bombay High Court sets aside IMPPA’s award against Nikhil Dwivedi’s Saffron Magicworks
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

According to a statement issued by Saffron Magicworks, the court set aside the impugned award passed by IMPPA’s Dispute Resolution Committee (DRC), with the court recording that the suit stood disposed of and nothing further survived for consideration in the pending applications.

Adding to this, The development follows an interim order dated September 9, 2026, passed by Justice Arif S Doctor, under which the court had restrained IMPPA from declaring Saffron Magicworks a defaulter consequent to the disputed award until further orders.
Meanwhile, The September order had also recorded a statement made on instructions by counsel for Defendant No. 2 that the party would not act upon the impugned award.

Notably, Saffron Magicworks had approached the High Court challenging the award passed through IMPPA’s dispute resolution mechanism and seeking protection against its implementation and the consequences that could follow from it.

As per the latest buzz, In its latest order dated October 23, 2026, Justice Arif S Doctor specifically addressed IMPPA’s position, observing that since the association’s own committee had passed the purported award, IMPPA could not be aggrieved by its setting aside.
In further updates, The latest development assumes significance against the backdrop of the disagreement between the parties over the interpretation of the court’s earlier directions.

On top of that, Saffron Magicworks has alleged that IMPPA’s public statement on the proceedings was materially misleading on the central question of whether the association had been restrained by the court. The production house’s position was that the September 9 order expressly prohibited IMPPA from declaring it a defaulter on the basis of the July 3 award.
The production house further maintained that any suggestion that the court had imposed no such restraint was inconsistent with the wording of paragraph four of the order.

The property was purchased from Shreeja Devcon Private Limited and comprises commercial premises spread across the ground and first floors of DLH Mangal Murti in Santacruz West.

Adding to this, The combined carpet area of the two floors is 1,285 sq ft. The ground floor accounts for 575 sq ft, while the first floor has a carpet area of 710 sq ft. The agreement also includes one car parking space.

Meanwhile, Based on the reported transaction value of Rs 12.85 crores and the total carpet area of 1,285 sq ft, the property was acquired at approximately Rs 1 lakh per sq ft of carpet area. The deal adds to the list of high-value property transactions involving celebrities in Mumbai, where commercial and residential real estate continues to see significant activity in premium neighbourhoods.
Notably, The registration documents state that the agreement was executed with Shreeja Devcon Private Limited and formally registered on October 7.

title: Ramayana producer Namit Malhotra calls Los Angeles premiere his “Oscar moment” ahead of November 5 release
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
“I wanted to host this evening at the Academy Theatre because this is my Oscar moment,” Malhotra shared during his address.

Adding to this, Malhotra also spoke about his association with Los Angeles and his work in visual effects through DNEG. He noted that the company has won eight Academy Awards, including seven over the past 11 years, for its collaborations with filmmakers such as Christopher Nolan and Denis Villeneuve.

Meanwhile, Reflecting on his beginnings, he shared, “For a third generation movie family background, garage startup kid at 19 with an Apple computer working with three of his teachers who are all of 21, Merzin, Prakash and Josefa, this is what dreams are made of and what better place to share this moment than the city of Angels, Los Angeles.”

Notably, Malhotra also recalled moving to Los Angeles in 2007 as part of his efforts to build a company that could connect Indian and international movie industries. “In my pursuit of building a global company and connecting the east and the west I set foot in LA in 2007 and haven't looked back since,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, He further spoke about the financial difficulties he faced during the 2008 crisis and how the experience shaped his journey. “An immigrant who lost 90% of his wealth with the fun times in 2008 as I'm sure some of you may remember to bounce back today and being able to bring the biggest independent production in the world the Ramayana, I can't even tell you what it feels like to stand here today,” he shared.

In further updates, During his address, Malhotra brought the movie's key collaborators on stage. He introduced Nitesh Tiwari as the director, Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram and Sai Pallavi as Sita. “As you all can see Ram without Sita does not work. So please welcome Sai Pallavi,” he shared.

On top of that, He then introduced Yash, who plays Ravana in the movie, saying, “And the reason that you know this movie happened or the conflict happened is because they have to fight Raavan, and that is the rocking star Yash.” Malhotra also acknowledged the contribution of international and Indian talent involved in the project, including composer Hans Zimmer and choreographer Terry Notary.

Speaking about the larger vision behind Ramayana , Malhotra shared the movie brought together talent from both India and the West. “I stand here to showcase the best of India and the best of the west working together to create a motion picture that means more to billions of people around the world than you all can imagine,” he shared.

title: ‘Ravana is not all bad’: Sai Pallavi says key takeaway from Ramayana is to spot the Ravana in us and make changes over time
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

All eyes are on Ramayana as it gears up for rollout in a few days. Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi , Yash and director Nitesh Tiwari attended the Los Angeles premiere of Ramayana at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles. On the red carpet, Sai Pallavi spoke about the movie and shared what she hopes that audience takes away from the movie adaptation of the Indian epic.

Adding to this, Sai Pallavi has spoken about the portrayal of Ravana in Ramayana. What Sai Pallavi shared Sai Pallavi was asked that people in India have grown up with the story of Ramayana but what does she hope the people see differently in the movie in US. In response, Sai shared, “If one is curious about Indian culture, Indian epics, I think this could be the start where you see the best version of Ramayana that exists.” She shared that the movie has the best technicians on board along with advanced VFX.

Meanwhile, She went on to add, “At the same time, as a scripture, I think, if you are a believer, and you would see, try to introspect, and see what good and bad exists in you, and you learn to correct yourself over time. Because Ravana is not all bad. And it's important that we spot the Ravana in us, and we make changes over time.”

Notably, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the ancient Indian epic. Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi portrays Sita and Yash plays Ravana. The cast also includes Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. The movie is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, with music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer.

As per the latest buzz, As per reports mounted on a budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees, the movie is backed by Yash and Namit Malhotra and is planned as a two-part franchise. The first instalment is scheduled to rollout in theatres on November 5, 2026, with the second part expected to arrive around Diwali 2027.

title: Manoj Bajpayee recalls career low before Raajneeti, Gangs Of Wasseypur; says meetings with Neeraj Pandey, Anurag Kashyap changed everything
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Manoj Bajpayee has opened up about a low phase in his career before films such as Raajneeti, Gangs Of Wasseypur and Special 26 brought a significant change. The star recalled a time when he was turning down several offers because the kind of work he wanted to do was not coming his way. He also spoke about how conversations with filmmakers Prakash Jha, director of Raajneeti, Anurag Kashyap , director of Gangs Of Wasseypur, and Neeraj Pandey, eventually led to these films.

Adding to this, Manoj Bajpayee latest movie Gajab Raat is streaming on Netflix. Manoj Bajpayee on the low phase in his career Recalling that period, Manoj shared, “Before these films, I saw some lows. The kind of work that I wanted to do wasn’t coming my way. All I was doing was refusing films and saying no to people. And the ones I shared yes to, I wasn’t happy doing those films."

Meanwhile, The star explained that things began to change after he watched Neeraj Pandey's A Wednesday. He met the filmmaker afterwards. Around the same time, he also met Prakash Jha and was in touch with Anurag Kashyap.

Notably, Talking about how these meetings eventually led to new opportunities, Manoj shared, “That’s when I watched A Wednesday. Neeraj (Pandey) and I had met after that and we spoke about cinema at large. He told me how he makes his films. That’s all I remember from that chat. I also remember meeting Prakash (Jha) ji at around the same time. Anurag (Kashyap) and I were talking simultaneously. Those films started happening to me a year after those meetings."

As per the latest buzz, Manoj went on to share that he continues to speak to directors every day, including many newcomers. He shared these conversations help him discover interesting stories and find the kind of work he wants to do. The star added that his focus is on building a filmography that he can be proud of.

In further updates, Manoj was of late seen in Gajab Raat, which premiered on Netflix on October 23. Directed by Ritesh Shah and produced by Neeraj Pandey, the Hindi crime thriller unfolds over a single night in Delhi. Manoj plays a corrupt police officer whose encounter with an injured woman pulls him into a dangerous situation involving powerful people and a wider conspiracy. title: Radhika Apte slams trolls criticising Alia Bhatt's physique in Alpha, calls out double standards for female actors in action roles
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Alia Bhatt 's latest rollout, Alpha , faced criticism and eventually failed at the ticket-window. The star was seen in an action-packed avatar in the movie. However, many viewers criticised her for lacking the physicality required for an action role. In a recent interview with India Today, Radhika Apte questioned why female actors are scrutinised for their physique when taking on action roles, while their male counterparts rarely face the same judgement.

Adding to this, Radhika Apte slams trolls criticising Alia Bhatt's action sequences in Alpha. Radhika Apte defends Alia Bhatt Radhika and Keerthy Suresh are set to star in the crime thriller series Akka. When asked about the audience's hesitation towards female actors leading crime dramas, the two actors shared they believed things were changing, citing examples such as Samantha Ruth Prabhu's performance in The Family Man and Kalyani Priyadarshan's role in Lokah. When they were told that Alia had been trolled for not fitting the part of an action hero in Alpha, Radhika hit back at the trolls, saying, "Your actors who are doing action have massive paunches and all, and Alia is bloody fit. I mean, please."

Meanwhile, Further explaining why these double standards exist, Radhika shared, "I think it's because most households and a large part of our country are quite traditional. You want women to be a certain way, dress a certain way, behave a certain way, and get married at a certain age. That still exists. Very few people are comfortable with the freedom that their daughters are seeking, or rather, rightfully claiming. I think that also reflects in the kind of content people watch. That's my guess."

Notably, Alia faced criticism for her role in Alpha, with social media users questioning her casting as an 18-year-old character despite being in her 30s. Her action avatar subsequently attracted criticism over her physique. The movie, directed by Shiv Rawail, also faced criticism for its storyline and dialogues. title: Jamia alleges campus vandalism amid protests, says university gates, CCTV cameras damaged
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Jamia Millia Islamia on Wednesday alleged widespread vandalism on its campus through Tuesday night, claiming that groups of protesting students and locals damaged university gates and boundary walls, brought down Gate 4C, threw stones, and damaged CCTV cameras and their control room amid an ongoing protest.

Adding to this, The allegations came amid protests against the university administration’s decision to restrict access to the campus. (PTI) In a statement on Wednesday, the university shared the incidents raised serious concerns about the safety of students, faculty members and non-teaching staff. It alleged that a group of masked protesters reached the university’s boys’ hostels to mobilise additional support.

Meanwhile, The allegations came amid protests against the university administration’s decision to restrict access to the campus, with hostel residents particularly angered by the closure of Gate 4C, which they use to enter the university.

Notably, A protesting student, not wishing to be identified, shared, “The university administration had sealed Gate 4C, which is used by hostel students to reach the university campus. There are two halls - Zakir Hussain Hall and Jauhar Hall -- that house eight hostels. Residents of these hostels were angry about the administration’s decision to close the entry. They broke the gate to gain entry to the campus.” He shared they will chalk out the further course of action on Wednesday.

As per the latest buzz, The university shared its proctorial team and teachers rushed to the campus after receiving reports of the attacks. It alleged that the scale and intensity of the damage were particularly concerning, with videos, CCTV footage and social media posts indicating that heavy iron rods, hammers and other tools had been used to damage university infrastructure.

In further updates, The administration alleged that women faculty members, wardens and provosts were threatened when they attempted to reason with female protesters. It shared the vandalism began shortly after another attempt by the university to hold dialogue with the protesting students.

On top of that, The statement shared the university administration had made seven attempts to engage with the protesters, including negotiations with committee members and teachers on Tuesday evening. The university expressed dismay at what it described as a contradiction between the students’ participation in discussions and the destruction that followed.

The incidents, it shared, came after a week of repeated instances of university gates and boundary walls being scaled, damaged and broken. The university has shifted to online mode, as notified on October 24.

title: Radhika Apte talks about avoiding South films, says fair-skinned North Indian female actors were favoured over local talent
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In her two-decade-long career, Radhika Apte has been part of several South Indian films, including Vetri Selvan, Rajinikanth’s Kabali and Lion. Her last South Indian movie was Chithiram Pesuthadi 2 (2019), which rolled out six years after she shot for it. In a recent interaction, Radhika opened up about why she has consciously kept away from South Indian cinema, saying she felt the industry had a bias towards fair-skinned female actors.

Adding to this, Radhika Apte is currently busy with the promotions of her next movie Akka. 'North Indian female actors were cast down south because they were fairer' In conversation with News18, Radhika shared, “I could be wrong but in my perception, north Indian actresses were cast down south because they were fairer. I’m not fair. I wonder, why they wouldn’t cast south Indian actresses in south Indian films and get north Indian actresses instead. And here, they want foreigners. We’ve a tendency to do that. I didn’t want to promote that. Women down south are absolutely beautiful, talented and amazing, who know the language really well. They’re excellent performers. I think they should get cast in south films rather than people coming from Bombay, who can’t speak a word in that language and get their voices dubbed by others. I wasn’t very much in favour of all that.”

Meanwhile, Radhika also shared that the atmosphere on South Indian movie sets was informal, which could have both advantages and disadvantages. She shared, “I did my last south movie ten years back. And what I recollect is that things were a bit more informal there. A lot of things happened out of dosti. They were very soft and kind. They would tell me, ‘You’re like family now.’ They treated you as though you were their sister. But that would mean that I would also have to do things out of favour. That would become a problem. But it was also nice because you felt you could go and chat with them.”

Notably, Radhika will next be seen in Akka, a Netflix gangster drama set in the 1980s in the fictional South Indian kingdom of Pernuru. She plays Rudra, who finds herself in a power struggle with Bhavani, played by Keerthy Suresh.

As per the latest buzz, Written and directed by Dharmaraj Shetty and produced by YRF Entertainment, the series explores power, loyalty, rivalry and revenge. Akka is set to premiere on Netflix on October 30, 2026.

title: Govinda recalls mother's struggles after she became a heroine, reveals why she shaved her head and became a Sadhvi
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Govinda has often spoken about sharing a close bond with his late mother, Nirmala Devi. In a recent interview with ABP Live, Govinda spoke about his mother's sacrifices, recalling why she gave up her acting career and became a spiritual ascetic.

Adding to this, Govinda opens up about his mother's struggles. Govinda talks about her mother's sacrifice Nirmala Devi began her career as a leading star in Hindi cinema but stepped away from the industry after less than a decade. Govinda recalled, "After becoming a heroine, my mother Nirmala Devi got poor to such an extent that all the stuff from our bungalow was taken away."

Meanwhile, Explaining why his mother became a sadhvi, Govinda shared, "My father told her, ‘Nirmala, you’re so pretty that when you go out to ask for work, people would ogle at you.’ So my poor mother got her shaved off and became a saint. She shared, ‘Let my children grow up'. Being the son of such a mother, I don’t care about who’s saying what about me. I’m not even looking in that direction."

Notably, Govinda also opened up that his mother never wanted him to become a hero. Recalling how she reacted when he expressed his desire to become an star, he shared she felt he was too innocent for the demands of the entertainment industry. She also did not want him to smoke or drink alcohol. Govinda opened up that his mother wanted him to take up a bank job, while his father believed in his potential.

As per the latest buzz, Nirmala Devi was an star and Hindustani classical vocalist who began her movie career in the early 1940s. She made her acting debut with Savera (1942), directed by V C Desai, in which she starred alongside Arun Kumar Ahuja, whom she married in the same year. She went on to appear in films such as Sharda (1942), Kanoon (1943), Geet (1944), Gaali (1944) and Piya Milan (1945). Her performance in Chalis Karod (1946) also received positive reviews.

In further updates, She later featured in Ghunghat (1946) and Sehra (1948), a home production made by her husband. She continued acting in films such as Anmol Ratan (1950) and Jai Mahalakshmi (1951), which marked her final screen appearance. Although she stepped away from acting relatively early, she continued pursuing music and established herself as a Hindustani classical vocalist known for her thumri performances.

On top of that, Govinda is set to return to the big screen after nearly seven years with Roopa and Duniyadari. He revealed the two films in July 2026. He will star opposite newcomer Rani Swarnkar in Roopa and is also producing the project. Govinda has described it as a suspense drama aimed at younger audiences, with elements of comedy.

'Vicky is wise in practice, I am wise in theory' In conversation with Vogue, Katrina lauded Vicky for being patient and a good listener, describing him as the perfect partner for someone like her, who tends to have a lot to say. She shared, "Vicky is an incredible husband. He is wise beyond his years, has strong family values and a true sense of integrity. I would say Vicky is wise in practice, and I am wise in theory. One of the best things about him is that he always gives me space to be myself while being a great listener, and I can have a lot to say sometimes.”

Meanwhile, Katrina also lauded Vicky's ability to be fully present with her and their son despite his hectic work schedule. However, she admitted that balancing their high-profile careers and parenthood has meant fewer romantic dinners and movie nights.

Notably, “As a father, he’s been amazing. He has this incredible superpower to be 100 per cent present in the moment with Vihaan and me, even when he is tired and has been working 14, 16 or 18 hours a day. Our romantic dinners and movie nights have taken a backseat for now, but Vicky keeps reminding me that everything will find its own time again,” she shared.

As per the latest buzz, Since becoming a mother, Katrina has largely stayed away from the spotlight. However, the star was of late spotted at Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations and out and about in Mumbai. She has also faced body-shaming comments following the birth of her son.

In further updates, Of late, at an event in London, Katrina responded to online trolls and spoke about the importance of not letting social media criticism affect one's self-worth. She shared, “I think we really need to be careful in letting the narrative on social media affect our self-worth. If we start trying to cater to all of them, I think that really hampers your ability to make choices for yourself. Personally, if every time I face critique or comments, I let that dictate my actions, I think I would have been paralysed with fear and unable to move ahead in my life.”

On top of that, Katrina has been selective about her movie roles since marrying Vicky in 2021. The couple welcomed their son in 2025. In addition to her acting career, Katrina has focused on expanding her makeup brand, Kay Beauty, which of late launched in the UK. On the movie front, she was last seen in the 2024 movie Merry Christmas, directed by Sriram Raghavan and co-starring Vijay Sethupathi.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

This marks the first official communication from the distribution company confirming that the movie will indeed be rolled out in India. Moreover, the poster mentions 'Filmed for IMAX', hinting that the movie will also get an IMAX rollout in the country. However, the exact rollout date is yet to be revealed. The poster simply mentions 'Only in theatres this November'.
Adding to this, A post shared by PVRINOX Pictures (@pvrpictures)

Meanwhile, A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , " Godzilla Minus Zero is a movie made for IMAX. So is Ramayana . Ramayana is a local movie and has a two-week exclusivity window on IMAX screens in India. Hence, if PVR INOX has mentioned IMAX on the poster and in the caption of its social media post, one can assume that Godzilla Minus Zero will most likely rollout in India two weeks later, on November 20 as Ramayana arrives on the big screen on November 5. However, they are still discussing whether they can rollout the movie on November 20 or somehow bring the movie to cinemas on November 13. An official announcement should arrive soon."

Notably, Bollywood Hungama had earlier reported that Godzilla Minus Zero would get limited showcasing in India's IMAX properties. This means that at most IMAX cinemas, it is likely to get just one show, while the remaining shows will be allotted to Ramayana . When asked about this, the trade source replied, "Yes, that's what is expected to happen, though a final call will be taken closer to the rollout."

So, it'll be a challenge to divide shows between these three films in the third week of November, should The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping also rollout in IMAX."

title: Ramayana first reactions: Viewers compare Ranbir Kapoor-Yash's film to Lord of the Rings, music receives mixed response
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The much-awaited movie Ramayana , starring Ranbir Kapoor , Yash, Sai Pallavi and several other actors, had its premiere in Los Angeles on October 27. Following the grand premiere, the first reactions to Nitesh Tiwari’s ambitious adaptation of the Indian epic have started pouring in. While viewers have lauded its scale, visuals and performances, with comparisons being made to The Lord of the Rings. However, some have not been impressed by the movie's music.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash and director Nitesh Tiwari attended the Los Angeles premiere of Ramayana at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles. (Pic: AFP) (AFP) 'Even Lord Of The Rings doesn't compare' A content creator shared his review after watching the movie at the Los Angeles premiere. He compared it to The Lord of the Rings and described it as a cinematic experience unlike anything he had seen before. He shared, "There is nothing like Ramayana in the cinematic universe. I haven't felt like this since the very first Lord Of the Rings movie came out. This movie is very grand and very epic. The character of Rama, that character is just wow. The cliffhanger in the end...I mean when that movie ended I shouted 'no' because there is a second part of this movie as well. The closest thing to this movie is Lord Of The Rings and even that doesn't compare. It is a hefty 3-hour movie. I can't believe what I just watched."

Meanwhile, Another viewer lauded Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's performances, calling the movie spectacular. The viewer wrote, "Ramayana Rise of a Legend was spectacular! The visuals, the dances, the music, the action were all colossal. Ranbir Kapoor was sublime, Yash was magnetic. One of this year’s most immersive cinematic experiences. A grand spectacle!"

Notably, Another viewer mentioned how Ranbir's performance moved her to tears. The comment read, “The star playing Prince Raama (Ranbir Kapoor) is some serious talent, moved to tears! An unforgettable experience. Full #Ramayana review on Friday.”

As per the latest buzz, Another review offered a mixed reaction, praising the movie's ambition and scale but noting that it sometimes prioritises spectacle over emotional storytelling. It read, “A hugely ambitious movie mounted on a grand scale, and the effort behind it is clearly visible. The team largely stays true to the Ramayana, but the movie leans more on spectacle and action than drama and emotion, leaving parts of the narration feeling flat and even serial like at times.”

In further updates, The review also raised concern about the second half being a bit dragged. However, the review lauded the performances by lead stars. "Yash as Ravana is the biggest highlight and is superb, especially in his introduction portions. Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi are solid as Ram and Sita, though the divine aura and emotional weight don’t always fully translate on screen."

On top of that, The review also noted that the movie's grand scale is hard to miss but criticised its music, a collaboration of AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer, calling it a major letdown. It shared, "The biggest negative, hands down, is the music. For a story like Ramayana, the score has to carry much of the divinity and emotion, but the Indian-Hollywood blend largely backfires and ends up feeling like neither apart from a few scenes."

Another review similarly criticised the music and pacing, saying the movie did not fully deliver the spiritual and emotional impact expected from the epic. It read, "The music is the biggest letdown, failing to create the spiritual and emotional impact this epic deserves. The second half feels stretched, with lengthy action sequences that add little to the overall impact. A visually ambitious attempt with some strong moments, but not quite the epic experience expected. A mixed bag with plenty of untapped potential."

title: Parineeti Chopra dismisses fued rumours with Jennifer Winget, slams those ‘manufacturing controversies’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

However, some clips sparked speculation of a rift between Parineeti Chopra and Jennifer Winget , with social media users accusing Parineeti of deliberately ignoring Jennifer out of jealousy. Both actors have now dismissed the rumours, describing themselves as a team.

Adding to this, Parineeti Chopra slams rumours about ignoring Jennifer Winget at Shaque success party. Parineeti Chopra slams rumours about ignoring Jennifer Winget The speculation began after a video showed Jennifer and Parineeti standing next to each other before the team gathered to cut a cake. Due to limited space, Jennifer was pushed behind Parineeti as the group moved forward. During a group photograph, Jennifer was also seen trying to peek out from behind Parineeti to ensure she was visible in the frame. The moment soon became a talking point on social media, with several videos alleging that Parineeti had deliberately pushed Jennifer back.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Viral_Womeniya (@viral_womeniya)

She was my favourite in Shaque, and what a brilliant star she is! To those manufacturing controversies for a few minutes of fame - perhaps try doing something meaningful with your lives? But thanks for the entertainment. We needed a good laugh."

On top of that, Directed by Rensil D'Silva and produced by Siddharth P. Malhotra and Sapna Malhotra under Alchemy Productions, the series features Parineeti Chopra, Jennifer Winget, Soni Razdan, Anup Soni, Tahir Raj Bhasin, Sumeet Vyas, Harleen Sethi and Dhruv Choudhry.

The series premiered on Netflix on 24 September 2026 and received mixed reviews from critics.

title: Nitesh Tiwari clarifies AI is only used for lip-sync in Ramayana, says all voices dubbed by real artists
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Nitesh Tiwari’s movie Ramayana had its grand premiere in Los Angeles on October 27. Producer Namit Malhotra , Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi arrived in traditional attire for the event, along with Nitesh. While interacting with the press, Nitesh dismissed claims that artificial intelligence (AI) was being used to dub Ramayana: Rise of a Legend into different languages.

Adding to this, Nitesh Tiwari refutes claims that AI was used for Ramayana dubbing. (Pic: AFP) (AFP) ‘All the voices are dubbed by artists’ The filmmaker verified that AI has been used only to synchronise lip movements with dubbed dialogue. He maintained that the voices were recorded by real artists and shared the technology would help audiences around the world watch the movie in their preferred languages.

Meanwhile, He shared, “As far as AI is concerned, it's only being used to lip sync, so that we can present the movie to the world in their language. All the voices are dubbed by the artists. AI has only been used to get the lip movement right, so that the audience can enjoy it in their native language. No AI has been used in dubbing, voice is dubbed by real artists only, AI is being used to lip sync.”
Notably, Nitesh’s comments come at a time when AI’s role in cinema is being debated, including concerns about how the technology could affect dubbing artists around the world.

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, Yash, who has co-produced the movie and plays Ravana, spoke about the importance of taking the story to a global audience. This story has travelled for thousands of years, and I think we are proud to present this story to the world and hope that it will give a message to the world about India as a culture, heritage, and what it offers to the world. title: Sara Ali Khan says she had no godfather in Bollywood, no father ‘begging people to take me in their films’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Sara Ali Khan comes from a well-established movie family. Her grandmother, Sharmila Tagore, and both her parents, Amrita Singh and Saif Ali Khan, are well-known names in the industry. In an interview with Filmfare, Sara acknowledged that being a star kid gave her an advantage in Bollywood but shared the constant focus on nepotism often takes away from the effort she has put into her career.

Adding to this, Sara Ali Khan talks about nepotism and family legacy. Sara Ali Khan talks about nepotism When asked whether her family legacy had helped her or weighed her down, Sara shared, “It's a combination of both. I'm not naive or delusional enough to not accept and be grateful for the fact that it has opened doors. It has given me access; it has given me recognition and fame, maybe even before I became an star. But having shared that, sometimes I do feel that the bar is too high. Nepotism has just become a bad word for people. And what I don't appreciate is that it takes away from the effort that one has made. I've shared this before and I'll say it again. Whether it's Janhvi, Ananya or me, we haven't chosen who we were born to.”

Meanwhile, She added, “We were just fortunate enough. I don't think it's fair to be hung for what's not our fault. Do I feel we have an edge? Yes, for sure. We were given a debut that people crave for. But eight years into my career, having to still explain that to people… I don't think that that onus should lie on me. I live with a single mother. I've not had a father going to offices, negotiating my contracts and begging people to take me in their films. When I had a problem with Kedarnath, I was sorting it out myself. There was no one with me. It's a double-edged sword. Because I've not had a godfather in the industry at all.”

Notably, Sara comes from a prominent Bollywood family with a legacy spanning several generations. She is the daughter of actors Saif Ali Khan and Amrita Singh and the granddaughter of veteran star Sharmila Tagore and former Indian cricket captain Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi.

As per the latest buzz, On her mother's side, Sara is the granddaughter of writer and politician Rukhsana Sultana. Her parents divorced in 2004, and she was raised primarily by her mother. Sara made her Bollywood debut opposite Sushant Singh Rajput in Kedarnath (2018) and went on to appear in films such as Simmba, Atrangi Re, Zara Hatke Zara Bachke and Ae Watan Mere Watan.

In further updates, Sara is currently seen in Udta Teer . Directed by Aakash Kaushik in his directorial debut, the spy comedy is produced by Karan Johar, Adar Poonawalla, Guneet Monga, Apoorva Mehta and Achin Jain under the banners of Dharma Productions and Sikhya Entertainment.

On top of that, The movie stars Ayushmann Khurrana in the lead role, alongside Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Gulshan Grover, Mukul Dev, Suhail Nayyar, Supriya Pilgaonkar, Brijendra Kala and Sandeep Anand in supporting roles. The movie received a mixed response from audiences and critics.

title: Director Rajiv Rai says replacing Sanjay Dutt in Yudh after actor faced personal issues cost him their friendship
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Rajiv Rai of late opened up about his broken friendship with Sanjay Dutt after he replaced the star in his directorial debut, Yudh (1985). In conversation with Vickey Lalwani, Rajiv explained that he had to replace Sanjay because the star was going through personal difficulties at the time.

Adding to this, Sanjay Dutt was replaced in the 1985 movie Yudh by Jackie Shroff. (Ayush Sharma) Replacing Sanjay Dutt in Yudh cost Rajiv Rai his friendship He shared, “ Sanjay Dutt was going through a personal issue for those days and hence I could not complete Yudh with him.” Rajiv shared that his family shared a close bond with the Dutts. His father, Gulshan Rai, had financed Sanjay's debut movie, Rocky, which was directed by the star's father, Sunil Dutt. Rajiv also shared that his father and Sunil Dutt had a close friendship.

Meanwhile, While Rajiv's father and Sunil Dutt continued to be friends, Rajiv shared that replacing Sanjay in Yudh damaged his friendship with the star. He shared, “We are friends on the surface now, but there is no close friendship anymore. I may have visited his home once or twice after the incident. Before that we had a really deep friendship, which broke. I was not happy making that decision as well. Sometimes, when I think about it I feel I shouldn't have done it.”

Notably, Rajiv shared that Sanjay was supposed to play Jackie Shroff's role in the movie. However, after he could not complete the movie, the entire movie had to be reshot, with only 20–30% remaining to be shot. Even Anil Kapoor was recast in the movie, the director shared.

As per the latest buzz, Rolled out in 1985, Yudh marked Rajiv Rai's directorial debut. Produced by his father, Gulshan Rai, the action thriller starred Jackie Shroff, Anil Kapoor in a double role, Tina Munim, Nutan, Danny Denzongpa and Hema Malini, among others. The movie follows a police officer and a lawyer whose lives become intertwined in a story involving kidnapping, crime and family secrets. Rajiv Rai went on to direct films such as Tridev (1989), Vishwatma (1992), Mohra (1994) and Gupt (1997).

In further updates, Sanjay Dutt has continued to work across Hindi and regional cinema. In 2026, he appeared in films including The Raja Saab, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, Raja Shivaji, Aakhri Sawal and 7 Dogs. He also starred in Haiwaan, rolled out in September 2026. Among his soon-to-release projects is Khalnayak Returns, a sequel to his 1993 hit Khal Nayak.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Speaking about his association with the project, Vardhaan shared the movie had become a personal experience over the past year and had deepened his appreciation for the sacrifices made by members of the armed forces and their families. “Being a part of the movie Param Veer has been an experience that has touched, moved, and inspired me in ways I could never have imagined. What began as a movie has, over the past year, become a deeply personal and transformative journey,” the star shared.

Adding to this, He added that working on a story centred on soldiers had strengthened his respect for their service and the sacrifices made by their families. “Working on this movie has given me a profound sense of gratitude and an even greater respect for our soldiers and their families, who make extraordinary sacrifices for our nation,” Vardhaan shared.

Meanwhile, The star also acknowledged director Sumant Raturi’s approach to the project and the team's work on bringing the historical subject to the screen. “Sumant Sir’s vision, along with the love and conviction with which the entire team has brought this story to life, makes this movie incredibly special. I am truly excited for the audiences to experience the movie and the spirit behind the movie,” he shared.

Notably, Reflecting on the significance of the Battle of Gangasagar, Vardhaan described the movie as an opportunity to revisit the experiences of soldiers whose contributions deserve to be remembered. “The legend of The Battle of Gangasagar is not just a story from our history; it is a tribute to the bravehearts who shaped it, and a reminder that behind every soldier’s sacrifice are countless stories of courage, love, and dedication that deserve to be remembered,” he added.

As per the latest buzz, With Param Veer , Vardhaan takes on a project rooted in India's military history. The makers are yet to share further information about his character, the rest of the cast and the movie's theatrical rollout.

title: Imran Khan gets interim relief as Bombay High Court puts FRRO’s ‘Leave India Notice’ on hold till November 2
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A Division Bench comprising Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna passed the direction after the Central government sought more time to respond to Khan’s petition. The Centre’s counsel also assured the court that no coercive action would be taken against the star in the interim.

Adding to this, During the hearing, the Additional Solicitor General (ASG), representing the Centre, requested that the matter be listed on Monday, November 2. Senior Advocate Venkatesh Dhond, appearing for Khan, pointed out that the star had been directed to leave India the following day under the FRRO notice.

Meanwhile, The ASG subsequently assured the bench that no action would be taken against Khan before the next hearing. The court then adjourned the matter and ordered that the challenged FRRO directive remain suspended until the next hearing.

Notably, Khan filed his petition on October 17, seeking to quash the FRRO’s October 14 “Leave India Notice”. He also sought interim protection against deportation, lookout notices and interference with his Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) status.

As per the latest buzz, The notice followed Khan’s brief detention by the police after he participated in protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. A complaint was also filed by BJP leader Kirit Somaiya over alleged public-order violations.

In further updates, In his petition, Khan argued that the FRRO issued the notice because he had attempted to attend the protest. He alleged that the authorities acted hastily and without giving him a prior hearing, claiming that political pressure and social media campaigns had influenced the decision.
On top of that, Khan further contended that the authorities had bypassed the safeguards provided under Section 7D of the Citizenship Act, which governs the cancellation of OCI registration.

On October 17, the FRRO also issued a show-cause notice under Section 7D concerning the possible cancellation of Khan’s OCI status. However, this separate notice has not been challenged in the current petition, according to the details of the case.

title: Gondhal trailer out: Santosh Davakhar’s Oscar-submitted film to release in seven languages on November 13, 2026
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

According to the makers, the multilingual rollout will cover markets including India, the US, the UK, Europe, Australia, Dubai and Africa. The movie’s makers have described it as the first Marathi movie to receive a seven-language global theatrical rollout.

Adding to this, Set against the cultural traditions of Maharashtra, Gondhal follows newlyweds Suman and Anandrao, whose lives take an unsettling turn as personal desires, marital responsibilities and devotion begin to intersect. The trailer offers glimpses of the couple’s strained circumstances and a series of mysterious events that form the basis of the psychological thriller.
Meanwhile, Speaking about the movie’s international reach, writer-director Santosh Davakhar shared he wanted to introduce audiences to a lesser-seen aspect of Indian culture through the story.

Notably, “Global perceptions of Indian cinema are often shaped by narratives of poverty and caste conflict – important realities, but not the complete expression of India. Gondhal is not a movie but generations of culture, people, traditions coming together. Getting the world to know about this tradition is something that makes me immensely happy,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, Davakhar also spoke about the role of international movie platforms in bringing regional stories to audiences beyond their place of origin. “Global festivals like academy awards help filmmakers to bring forth the ethnicity of our very roots across continents and not only in India. To experience India in its truest form. I created this movie to bring one such powerful tradition to the global screen through a culturally authentic and universal cinematic language,” he added.

In further updates, Gondhal has been selected as India’s official submission for the 99th Academy Awards in the Best International Feature Movie category. The makers have also shared the movie is being considered in multiple categories, although further details about those submissions have not been specified.

On top of that, Davakhar previously won the Silver Peacock for Best Director at the 56th International Movie Festival of India (IFFI). The festival jury described Gondhal as “like a Shakespearean fable set in a real world.”

The movie stars Ishita Deshmukh, Kishor Kadam, Yogesh Sohani and Nishad Bhoir. It is produced by Santosh Davakhar and Diksha Davakhar under the banner of Davakhar Films, with cinematography by Amalendu Chaudhary. The movie opens with a 25-minute unbroken take, according to the makers.

title: Ganesh Acharya turns lyricist for the first time with ‘Kar Mehnat’, sung by Sonu Nigam
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The song comes ahead of the movie’s theatrical rollout on December 11, 2026. Acharya, who has spent decades working across choreography, acting and filmmaking, has now added songwriting to his creative pursuits by penning the lyrics for the track.

Adding to this, Speaking about the song, Acharya shared, “‘ Kar Mehnat ’ is a very special song for me because, for the first time, I have written lyrics for a song in my own movie. I have always believed that there is no substitute for hard work. No matter who you are or where you come from, everyone has dreams, and everyone faces challenges. This song is for every person who is working hard to achieve something in life. I believe people will connect with its emotions and message because, in some way, it reflects what we all experience. Having Sonu Nigam lend his voice to my words makes it even more special.”
Meanwhile, A post shared by Zee Music Company (@zeemusiccompany)
Notably, Sonu Nigam shared the song’s message and lyrics appealed to him, particularly because of their focus on everyday experiences and the importance of staying committed to one’s goals.

As per the latest buzz, Sharing his thoughts, the singer shared, “‘ Kar Mehnat ’ carries a beautiful and meaningful message. Hard work, patience and perseverance are emotions that everyone can relate to, regardless of their profession or background. What I particularly liked was the sincerity of the lyrics. Ganesh ji has expressed something very simple yet powerful, and I feel that is what will connect with listeners. I am happy to be associated with a song that encourages people to keep believing in themselves and their dreams.”
In further updates, The collaboration brings together Acharya’s first attempt at writing song lyrics and Nigam’s vocals for a track centred on determination and ambition.

On top of that, Ganesh: Dust to Stardust is written and directed by Ganesh Acharya and produced by Soundarya Acharya under V2S Production & Entertainment. The screenplay and dialogues are by Digangana Suryavanshi and Acharya, while Junaid Kumar has composed the music and background score. The movie also features lyrics by Sameer Anjaan alongside Acharya.

The technical team includes cinematographer Ajay Pandey, editor Rakesh Ram and production designers Amrish Yamanappa Patange and Daya Vanniyar of Red Ameise. Acharya and his team have handled the choreography.

title: SCOOP: Salman Khan’s Maatrubhumi STILL awaits CBFC screening despite government clearance; November 13 release eyed to avoid clashes with Yeh Prem Mol Liya, Gunmaaster G9, Eetha
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “The makers of Maatrubhumi applied for censor certification at the beginning of October. However, the CBFC hasn't given them a date for the movie's screening. There was an assurance that the screening would take place on Monday, October 26. However, it did not happen. Salman Khan flew to Delhi a few times to request the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting to facilitate the screening.”

Adding to this, The source continued, “Salman Khan is not asking for any special favours. He has made the changes that the Ministry wanted and has followed all the rules while applying for certification. He aims to rollout the movie in cinemas next month and hence, wants the CBFC to view the movie at the earliest.”

Meanwhile, Bollywood Hungama had also informed readers that Salman Khan was keen to bring Maatrubhumi to cinemas on November 13. When asked whether the plan was still on, the source replied, “The plan is very much on, subject to the CBFC issuing the certificate in time.”

Notably, Explaining the reason behind Salman Khan's preference for November 13, the source revealed, “Bhai doesn't believe in clashes and no other movie has taken the November 13 slot. Moreover, Rajshri Productions' Yeh Prem Mol Liya and the much awaited Emraan Hashmi-starrer Gunmaaster G9 are scheduled for rollout on November 27. Salman is clear that he wants to rollout Maatrubhumi two weeks before this movie so that all the three films can do well at the ticket window. As a result, he ruled out a November 20 rollout. He has also made it clear that he won't clash with Yeh Prem Mol Liya as it is directed by Sooraj Barjatya, who is like family to him.”

As per the latest buzz, The source further shared, “December 4 was also considered. However, Jio Studios is distributing Maatrubhumi and is also releasing the Shraddha Kapoor-starrer Eetha on the same date. They explained that it wouldn't be possible for them to rollout two films on the same day, and Salman found their point valid. Hence, November 13 seemed like the most suitable date. Now, it all depends on the CBFC and whether the movie gets certified in time.”

title: Janhvi Kapoor says Shikhar Pahariya took break from studies in London and moved to Juhu to be near her after Sridevi’s death
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Janhvi Kapoor is set to appear on Karan Johar ’s Koffee With Karan alongside her Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari co-star Varun Dhawan . According to The Indian Express, Janhvi opened up about her relationship with Shikhar Pahariya on the soon-to-release episode, recalling how he stood by her like a pillar of strength after her mother, Sridevi, died in 2018.

Adding to this, Janhvi Kapoor recalls Shikhar Pahariya's support after Sridevi's death. Janhvi Kapoor on Shikhar Pahariya's support after Sridevi's death Janhvi and Shikhar have been rumoured to have been dating for several years, although they have not publicly verified their relationship. Their frequent appearances together at family gatherings and public events have continued to fuel speculation. In the soon-to-release episode, Karan as per reports recalls witnessing Shikhar’s support for Janhvi after Sridevi’s death, even though the two were not officially dating at the time.
Meanwhile, When Karan asks Janhvi whether she always knew Shikhar was her “endgame”, she recalls how he quietly rearranged his life to be there for her after the tragedy.

Notably, She says, “I think he was studying in London, he took like half a semester off. He came to Bombay and he used to stay in town with his dad then, and he moved to his, which I only found out much later, he moved to his friend's house in Juhu for like a month. Not that I was seeing him every day or anything like that, but later on I just found out that he was like, no, in case she needs me, I just want to be around."

As per the latest buzz, Veteran star Sridevi died on February 24, 2018, aged 54, in Dubai, where she had travelled to attend a family wedding. Her death shocked the movie industry and her followers. Although initial reports suggested cardiac arrest, Dubai authorities later verified that she had died due to accidental drowning in the bathtub of her hotel room.

In further updates, Her body was brought back to Mumbai on February 27, and her funeral took place the following day. Several movie industry colleagues and thousands of followers gathered to pay their last respects.

On top of that, Janhvi hinted at her relationship with Shikhar during her appearance on Koffee With Karan 8 in 2023, when she named “Shiku”, her nickname for him, as one of the three people on her speed dial.

In April 2024, she was spotted wearing a necklace bearing his name at the screening of her father Boney Kapoor’s movie Maidaan. A month later, she spoke about their bond in an interview, revealing that Shikhar had been part of her life since she was 15 or 16. She described them as each other’s support system and shared their dreams had always been intertwined.

title: Ranbir Kapoor has hilarious explanation for Sai Pallavi choosing to become actor over a doctor on Amitabh Bachchan's KBC 18. Watch
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Despite completing her MBBS, Sai Pallavi chose not to pursue a career as a practising doctor and instead entered the movie industry, making her acting breakthrough with the Malayalam movie Premam. On Kaun Banega Crorepati 18 , host Amitabh Bachchan questioned her decision to choose acting over medicine, prompting her Ramayana co-star Ranbir Kapoor to offer a hilarious explanation.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi to appear on Kaun Banega Crorepati 18. Sai Pallavi on why she chose to become an star The cast of Ramayana, including Ranbir, Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey, is set to appear on Amitabh Bachchan’s quiz show to promote the movie. In a promo for the soon-to-release episode, Bachchan asks Sai about her decision to pursue acting after studying medicine.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by sonytvofficial (@sonytvofficial)

Notably, “You studied to become a doctor. And then you ended up here. How?” he asks. Sai replies, “God wrote it that you act,” suggesting that she was destined to become an star. Her response leaves the host perplexed, prompting Ranbir to add a humorous twist to her explanation.
As per the latest buzz, “Bhagwan ka prescription tha Sir (God wrote in his prescription) that she has to act,” he says, drawing cheers and applause from the audience.

In further updates, In another promo, Sai opens up about her initial reaction when she was offered the role of Sita in Ramayana. She says, “I didn’t want to use my head this time. Every time when I play a character, I think, 'What can I give to that character? ' but this was the first time when I thought, 'What can I get for playing a role like that of Sita Maa? Like what knowledge will I gain from this?' So, I wanted to keep the process transparent. I didn’t want to think about anything. I prayed to Sita Maa and went forward with it.”

On top of that, Special episodes featuring the Ramayana cast are scheduled to air on October 29 and 30. She plays Aayesha Malik, a popular student who is found dead, and her twin sister Aditi, who refuses to believe that her death was accidental. Determined to uncover the truth, Aditi enters St. Teresa’s and participates in the Student of the Year competition, where her sister’s friends and rivals become potential suspects.

Meanwhile, As Aditi navigates the school’s competitive environment, she finds herself caught between rivalries, hidden secrets and the pressure to win. The contest becomes part of her investigation, with each interaction potentially bringing her closer to the truth about her sister’s death.

Notably, Speaking about her role, Shanaya shared the two characters gave her an opportunity to explore contrasting personalities and choices. “Playing Ayesha and Aditi has been one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences for me as an star. While the two sisters may look alike, they couldn’t be more different in their personalities and the choices they make. Ayesha’s mysterious death sets the story in motion, while Aditi’s search for the truth unravels a world where appearances can be deceptive and even the closest relationships hold secrets,” she shared.

As per the latest buzz, The star added that the darker storyline was one of the aspects that drew her to the project. “What appealed to me the most about Student of the Year: After Dark is how it takes a much-loved franchise into an unexpected and new territory, where the stakes go far beyond competition and winning a title. It’s this fresh and intriguing take on a familiar world that made the experience so exciting for me,” Shanaya shared.

In further updates, Director Reema Maya described the series as a story about the pressures of competition and the consequences of an all-consuming desire to succeed. “Student Of The Year - After Dark is grit, angst and heart. It is for the youth of now. A popular franchise reimagined for current times. The trailer is a glimpse into the new world we have created. There is so much more in store!” she shared.

On top of that, Maya added, “I wanted to explore the relentless competition that our youth find themselves grappling with. What happens when the need to succeed becomes all-consuming - destroying friendships, and even oneself. Our characters are young, ambitious, flawed and certainly not above suspicion. It is a murder mystery - competition series, where the competition is part of the investigation. I had a lot of fun taking commercial tropes of characters and dissecting their psyche.”
Produced by Dharmatic Entertainment, Student of the Year: After Dark also stars Abhinav Singh, Divik Sharma, Manya Grover, Deeya Damani, Adi Malik, Sheeba Chaddha and Vivek Gomber.
