title: After Yash, Ramayana actor Suhail Nayyar urges audience to support film, says young Indian VFX artists have worked hard
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Yash of late urged audiences not to nitpick the visual effects (VFX) in Ramayana and to approach Nitesh Tiwari's soon-to-release movie with an open mind. Now, Suhail Nayyar, who plays Sugriva in the movie, has also appealed to audiences to support the movie. He spoke about the years of work that have gone into the project, particularly by young Indian VFX artists.

Adding to this, Suhail Nayyar plays Sugriva in Ramayana, Movie will rollout on Nov 5. ‘Don't put pressure, give blessings’ During a conversation, Suhail Nayyar acknowledged that the movie would inevitably face scrutiny but shared the focus should also be on the hard work happening behind the scenes. He particularly highlighted the young Indian artists who worked on the movie's visual effects.

Meanwhile, Suhail compared the situation to the Indian cricket team playing in a World Cup final. He shared that instead of putting more pressure on the players, followers support them and offer their blessings. He believes the same approach is needed for Ramayana.

Notably, He told India Today, “There are young Indian people handling VFX. They are around 19 to 25 years old, and they work so hard. And this is just one part of the team. If the Indian cricket team is in the World Cup final, you don’t put pressure on the team. You give them your blessings and say, ‘You win, we are with you.’ You don’t put pressure on them. It is wrong.”

As per the latest buzz, Suhail also spoke about the atmosphere on the sets of Ramayana and shared the people working on the movie had sincere intentions. He shared, “The intentions of the people working on this project are really pure, and I am saying this because I am a part of it. I have seen how these people conduct themselves and how they treat the written material. The atmosphere on set, the way people speak respectfully, all of that makes me feel very proud that I am part of this project."

In further updates, At a recent Ramayana pre-rollout event in Hyderabad, Yash urged audiences to support the movie and refrain from nitpicking over its visual effects. He also shared India needed to protect filmmakers such as producer Namit Malhotra, who are working to take Indian cinema to a global platform.

On top of that, Yash shared, “Anybody can dream of making a movie, but only a few people will have that kind of passion, dedication, determination and madness. As an Indian, I am telling you, we need to protect this guy. It's our responsibility because this man was comfortably doing business in LA. Every time I met him, he always spoke about one thing, ‘We all are doing so much and Indians have done so much, but we should do something for our Indian movie industry and I want to do it. I am getting Oscars, but I am not happy. I want our country to be placed at that level and that's the day I am going to be happy.’ This is what he told me.”

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is an soon-to-release two-part cinematic adaptation of the Hindu epic Ramayana. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The first part is scheduled to rollout in theatres on November 5, 2026.

title: Actor Imran Khan won’t be asked to leave India on Oct 28: Govt assures Bombay HC
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO), Mumbai, assured the Bombay high court on Tuesday that Bollywood star Imran Khan would not be asked to leave India on October 28, the deadline stipulated in the 'Leave India’ notice issued to him over his alleged participation in a political protest.

Adding to this, The Bombay High Court postponed star Imran Khan’s petition challenging a notice directing him to leave India. (REUTERS) After the FRRO sought time to take instructions, a division bench of Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna posted the matter for hearing on November 2.

Meanwhile, While senior counsel Venkatesh Dhond, appearing for Khan, argued that the matter has to be heard urgently since Khan has been asked to leave the country on Wednesday, additional Solicitor General (ASG) Anil Singh shared, “We are giving assurance as we are only seeking time”.

Notably, The notice, issued by the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO), Mumbai, directs Khan, a US citizen and Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholder to leave India by October 28 over his alleged participation in a political protest.

As per the latest buzz, Khan filed the petition on October 17 through MZM Legal, arguing that he had not violated the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025, or the Citizenship Act. He also contended that the notice did not specify the provision he had allegedly breached.

In further updates, The notice followed Khan’s participation in a protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar amid allegations of mishandling the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. On October 10, police detained the star, his partner Lekha Washington, his mother Nuzhat, his cousin Zayn Marie and several other protesters at August Kranti Maidan. They had joined activist Tushar Gandhi in supporting the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) campaign seeking the CEC’s resignation.

On top of that, After hundreds of protesters were detained, BJP leader Kirit Somaiya sought action against Khan, citing his alleged participation in political activity as a foreign national. The FRRO issued the notice on October 15.

Khan has denied violating the rules, saying no protest was underway when he reached the spot and that he did not cross the police barricades to enter the protest site. He shared he was apprehended after media personnel surrounded him as he returned to his vehicle.

title: Imran Khan’s ‘leave India’ notice put on hold, Bombay High Court grants interim relief until November 2
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Imran Khan is set to get temporary relief in his legal battle against a notice directing him to leave India by October 28. The Bombay High Court on Tuesday deferred the hearing on his petition until November 2 at 3 pm after the Centre';s counsel sought more time. The development comes a day before the deadline given to Imran by the Foreigners Regional Registration Office ( FRRO ) to leave the country. The star, who is a US citizen and holds an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card, has challenged the notice, calling it arbitrary and questioning the grounds on which it was issued.

Adding to this, Imran Khan’s October 28 exit deadline stays on hold as Bombay High Court defers hearing. (HT_PRINT) What happened at the hearing? According to Bar and Bench, a division bench comprising Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna briefly heard the matter on October 27. The Centre's counsel requested that the hearing be postponed to Monday, November 2, with the Additional Solicitor General Anil Singh assuring the court that no immediate action would be taken against Imran.

Meanwhile, Senior advocate Venkatesh Dhond, appearing for the star, pointed out that the star was required to leave India the following day under the FRRO notice. "Lordship may keep it on Monday," the ASG told the bench. "But I have to leave tomorrow (according to the FRRO directive)," he responded, as per the report.

Notably, The ASG told the court that Imran Khan could wait until Monday, assuring the bench that no action would be taken against him in the interim. He added that this was an oral assurance. The court subsequently adjourned the matter to November 2 at 3 pm, with the order under challenge to remain in abeyance until the next hearing.

As per the latest buzz, The case stemmed from an incident on October 10, when Mumbai Police detained the star near August Kranti Maidan. The star, a US citizen with an Overseas Citizen of India ( OCI ) card, was at the spot during a protest seeking Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. He was detained along with his partner Lekha Washington and his cousin Zayn Marie Khan.

In further updates, On October 14, the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) issued a Leave India Notice (LIN), asking Imran to leave India by October 28. The notice was issued under Sections 7(2)(C) and 29 of the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025.

On top of that, He challenged the notice through a writ petition, Imran Khan Pal v. Union of India & Ors., filed by lawyers Zulfiquar Memon, Parvez Memon and Kunal Vajani. He argued that the notice was arbitrary, violated Articles 14 and 21 of the Constitution, and had been issued without giving him a prior hearing or following the proper show-cause procedure.

According to the report, Imran Khan challenged the notice in the High Court, calling it “arbitrary, illegal, perverse and drastic.” In his petition, he questioned the basis for the order, saying it was issued “without disclosing any reasons, supporting material, or specific statutory contravention.”

She also revealed whom she considers the ideal husband in Bollywood, naming her father, the late star Dharmendra .

Esha Deol says Dharmendra was a perfect husband During the event, Esha was asked about the role a wife plays in supporting her husband through difficult times. We choose our husbands ourselves, or our parents chose them for us, if it is arranged, but they become a family. Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by All spotted video papss (@vijay__video_journalist)

Notably, When asked who she considered the perfect husband in Bollywood, Esha shared, “Maine kareebi se sirf papa ko dekha hai as a father and husband so I would say Dharam ji” (I have closely seen only my father in the roles of a father and a husband, so I would say Dharam ji).

As per the latest buzz, Dharmendra married Prakash Kaur in 1954, before making his debut in films. The couple had four children: sons Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol, both actors, and daughters Vijeta and Ajeeta, who have largely stayed away from the movie industry.

In further updates, Dharmendra later fell in love with star Hema Malini, whom he first met while working on the 1970 movie Tum Haseen Main Jawaan. Their on-screen pairing in films such as Sholay, Seeta Aur Geeta and Dream Girl became popular, and they married in 1980. Dharmendra remained married to Prakash Kaur. He and Hema Malini have two daughters, Esha Deol and Ahana Deol.

On top of that, Dharmendra died on November 24, 2025, at the age of 89, at his Mumbai residence, weeks before his 90th birthday. The veteran star had been admitted to Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai in October after experiencing breathlessness. He remained under medical care for several weeks before being discharged on November 12 to continue his treatment at home.
The movie follows a decorated encounter specialist who is imprisoned for murder. His subsequent journey of self-discovery reveals that his arrest is an act of retribution linked to his past.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Rajiv Rai CLARIFIES Mohra’s Diwali re-release plans: “I’m NOT coming against Ramayana”; reveals why Akshay Kumar-Suniel Shetty starrer won't release in multiplexes
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Rajiv Rai shared, “Yes, it is true that Mohra is being re-rolled out, but in a very, very limited and small way on single screens around the country. It will continue taking the rounds of different centres over a period of six months or so. So, will my latest movie Zora (which re-rolled out on October 23). Maybe my other old films might follow suit.”

Adding to this, Rajiv Rai also revealed, “These films are not going to rollout in PVR or other multiplex chains where ticket prices are steep and also because the VPF (Virtual Print Fee) charged by cinemas is high. Old films have been watched a million times and, in reality, the business is negligible. I am just doing this as an exercise. Of course, sometimes repeat-run films do very well, but it’s rare. You have to continuously move the films around India. If you do that, the collections can add up to a respectable total over time.”

Meanwhile, As for reports that Mohra is clashing with Ramayana , Rajiv Rai clarified, “I’m not coming against Ramayana . Because everyone has moved away from Diwali, there’s an opening in small centres and I’m trying to take advantage of that. Also, it’s an auspicious date to start something. Anyway, Ramayana cannot book all the cinemas in the country.”

Notably, He further emphasized, “There may not even be a cinema for Mohra in Mumbai and hence, there’s no clash with any movie. These old films are exhausted, but there’s always an interest among a certain class of audience. There are people who want to visit big screens for old films and for them, we are going to re-rollout Mohra .”

Keerthy Suresh is currently busy promoting her soon-to-release movie Akka , co-starring Radhika Apte . In a recent interaction, the star spoke about the career lull she faced after Mahanati (2018), the biopic on late star Savitri. Although she won the National Movie Award for Best Star for her performance in the movie, she did not receive any new projects for six months after its rollout.

Adding to this, Keerthy Suresh will next be seen in Akka with Radhika Apte. ‘My financial stability was going for a toss’ In conversation with News18, Keerthy recalled that she did not view the break as something unpleasant but was happy to have some time off after shooting back-to-back films. However, she soon realised that her financial stability was taking a hit as new projects stopped coming her way.

Meanwhile, “First of all, I needed a break at that time because I was working back-to-back. In a way, I was happy until I realised that my financial stability was going for a toss. But in those six months, I started doing nicer things.”
Notably, Keerthy, who has previously spoken about being body-shamed, shared that she also used the break to get into shape.

As per the latest buzz, “I used the time to transform myself and take care of my body. From 2013 to 2018, I only used to shoot, eat, sleep and repeat. There was nothing called workout in my life. I was like, ‘Mera face toh kaam kar raha hai (My face is working), why do I’ve to worry about my body?’ But that wasn’t the right perspective. I was a little plump and I wanted to get healthy – not because I wanted to look a certain way. In those six months, I started working out for the first time. That’s when I had a makeover.”
In further updates, The star added that she does not regret taking those six months off, as the experience helped her focus on herself and taught her how to manage her finances better.

On top of that, Keerthy also spoke about how filmmakers struggled to figure out what roles to offer her after Mahanati. Before the biopic, she had largely played girl-next-door characters, and the success of the movie changed how she was perceived in the industry. She shared the movie eventually opened doors to more substantial roles.

Set in the 1980s in Pernuru, a fictional South Indian city ruled by female gangsters, Akka follows a powerful sisterhood whose control is threatened by the arrival of a mysterious outsider. The series stars Keerthy Suresh and Radhika Apte in the lead roles and is directed by Dharmaraj Shetty. It is scheduled to premiere on Netflix on October 30.

title: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna’s team files cyber crime complaint in Hyderabad over alleged fake claims and online harassment
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In a statement, the Virosh team verified that its representative had physically submitted the complaint, along with relevant links and supporting evidence, for examination by the authorities. The team has clarified that its request is not intended to restrict freedom of speech or genuine criticism but seeks accountability in cases where potentially unlawful conduct or demonstrably false information may be involved.

Adding to this, The complaint has been filed by P. Nishanth Kumar, who is identified as the manager of both actors. According to the excerpts shared by the team, the representation seeks an impartial, evidence-led examination of specifically identified online publications and digital material. It asks the authorities to verify whether any of the material contains materially false factual representations, fabricated quotations or screenshots, deceptively altered images or videos, false attribution, impersonation or other conduct that could attract legal consequences.

Meanwhile, The complaint also refers to online claims concerning events allegedly occurring during the television programme, purported emotional distress or harassment, changes in social media following activity, and statements presenting a breakup, separation or divorce as fact. However, the complainant has shared that the authorities should not presume that any allegation is false or that any individual has committed an offence. Each instance, the representation says, should be examined against the available primary material, its origin and context.

Notably, The Virosh team has further shared that every identified instance of publishing, reposting or amplifying potentially unlawful content may be examined on its own merits. It has indicated that appropriate legal remedies will be pursued wherever warranted, in accordance with due process. The statement also calls for responsibility while sharing unverified claims and cautions against presenting speculation as established fact.

As per the latest buzz, The complaint follows the online scrutiny surrounding Vijay and Rashmika’s joint appearance on Koffee With Karan Season 9, during which the couple shared details about their relationship and journey towards marriage.

In further updates, During the conversation, Vijay spoke about Rashmika expressing her feelings first and recalled asking her to ask him “100 times” before he agreed. Rashmika subsequently explained that the remark needed to be understood in the context of the time they took to understand each other before making a commitment.

On top of that, Their comments and interactions became subjects of discussion across social media, with some users interpreting their remarks and body language critically. Older interviews and promotional clips featuring the actors also resurfaced, while details of their social media activity became part of the online debate.

Both actors subsequently responded to the criticism. Rashmika addressed the interpretation of Vijay’s remark and defended her relationship, while Vijay posted a statement affirming that the couple were “gloriously happy” and expressing his displeasure with the commentary surrounding their marriage.

title: Protests erupt after Odisha man held in narcotics case dies in Haryana police custody
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A man detained in a narcotics case died in Haryana Police’s custody in Odisha’s Malkangiri town, triggering protests by his family and local residents, people familiar with the matter shared on Tuesday.

Adding to this, According to the people, a team from Hansi police station picked up the 22-year-old man on charges of smuggling drugs on Sunday night (Representational image/Getty Images) According to the people, a team from Hansi police station picked up the 22-year-old man on charges of smuggling drugs on Sunday night and took him to a lodge in Malkangiri. His body was found in the hotel on Monday morning.

Meanwhile, The deceased’s family alleged that the police beat him to death and tried to pass it off as a suicide. The man’s death sparked tension in the area, with protesters burning tyres, blocking National Highway 326 and surrounding the Malkangiri police station, demanding the arrest of Haryana police personnel.

Notably, “We want to know why they kept him in a lodge instead of a local police station. If they could not establish his involvement, they should have rolled out him after proper verification,” shared Sameer Sarkar, a resident of MV-65 village.

As per the latest buzz, Malkangiri Superintendent of Police Vinod Patil shared an unnatural death case had been registered and an investigation was underway to establish the exact cause of death. “The body has been recovered and sent for postmortem. Further action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation,” Patil shared.

In further updates, Debabrata Mohanty is a senior assistant editor of Hindustan Times who works as state correspondent from Odisha covering the state's politics, governance, public policy, natural disasters, environment and its society for close to three decades. With his long years of reporting from the state capital of Bhubaneswar, Mohanty has been known as one of the most experienced and credible journalists covering Odisha for the national English dailies. His reporting combines on-ground detail with deep institutional knowledge detailing the state's changing politics, governance issues, administrative reforms and the functioning of its public institutions. He has regularly reported on issues ranging from legislative developments and public policy implementation. Politics is his core areas of expertise as he closely tracks Odisha's political landscape, including the rise and transformation of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), the Biju Janata Dal (BJD), the two principal political parties in Odisha. His long association with the state's political establishment enables him to write on contemporary developments in a larger political context. Mohanty takes a deep interest in writing human interest stories, environmental issues and documenting the impact of cyclones, floods, heatwaves, and other climate-related events in one of the most disaster-prone states. His coverage extends to public health, governance reforms and stories on accountability of government institutions. Before joining Hindustan Times, Mohanty worked with The Indian Express, Mail Today, and The Telegraph, where he covered at least six general elections and as many assembly elections. In 2007, he was selected for the prestigious Chevening Young Indian Print Journalist Programme at the University of Lincoln, United Kingdom, where he received advanced training in print journalism. title: Odisha tribals protest doctor’s arrest; police allege anti-mining violence role
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Hundreds of tribals held a protest in southern Rayagada district in Odisha on Monday to demand the rollout of Dr Randall Sequeira and karate instructor Laxman Naik. The two were arrested in connection with clashes over Vedanta’s proposed bauxite mining project, with protesters alleging that the police action is aimed at suppressing local opposition to mining.

Adding to this, Police have shared that Randall Sequeira, 39, was involved in violence against members of the public. (Linkedin/Randall Sequeira) The protesters, organised under the Niyamgiri Suraksha Samiti (NSS), gathered outside the Muniguda tehsil office and demanded the withdrawal of cases against activists and an end to alleged attempts to facilitate mining in the Niyamgiri hills. They have planned another protest in Sijimali on Tuesday.

Meanwhile, Police shared the two are accused of violence, criminal intimidation and other offences. Sequeira faces charges including attempted murder, rioting and offences under the Arms Act, while multiple provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) have been invoked in the case.

Notably, “Both were arrested for their alleged involvement in threatening members of the public and other serious offences. Sequeira has eight criminal cases registered against him, while Naik is named in 16 cases. Both were produced before a court following their arrest and their bail pleas were rejected, after which they were sent to Rayagada sub-jail,” shared Raj Prasad, Rayagada Superintendent of Police. “Dr RandallSequeira was not providing medical services to the people but was engaged in instigating tribals against the state government. Why would police arrest any innocent person, especially a doctor?” shared Akhileswar Singh, South Western Range DIG.

As per the latest buzz, Police shared the two were arrested by Kalahandi police from a rented house in Bhawanipatna at 11pm on October 16 and handed over to Rayagada police. They were arrested in connection with clashes on April 6 and 7 in Kantamal village of Kashipur where activists held a protest against the construction of a road linked to the proposed Sijimali bauxite mine.

In further updates, DIG Singh shared that the two men, accompanied by 25-30 people, had visited the home of two women in Kantamal who supported the mining project and threatened them to withdraw their support. According to police, one of the women had complained that her family was confined in their house for three days and denied food and water. She also alleged that she and her children had received death threats and that she was pressured to withdraw a police complaint.
On top of that, But the arrests have triggered protests among activists who shared Sequeira had provided free medical care to people in remote tribal villages for several years.

The 39-year-old doctor, who completed his MBBS at St John’s Medical College in Bengaluru and an MD in internal medicine from Sawai Man Singh Medical College in Rajasthan, came to Kalahandi in 2017 and later began visiting remote villages to provide healthcare.

title: In 1989, 38 YO Naseeruddin Shah raised concerns about romancing teenager Sonam Khan in Tridev, said his daughter was older than her: Director reveals
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Naseeruddin Shah played a romantic role opposite star Sonam Khan in the 1989 movie Tridev. In a recent interaction, the movie's director Rajiv Rai spoke about how Naseeruddin was mindful of the age gap between him and Sonam. While Sonam was a teenager at the time of the shoot, Naseeruddin was 38 years old.

Adding to this, Naseeruddin Shah was concerned about romancing Sonam Khan in Tridev. ‘I have a daughter who is Sonam's age’ In a recent interaction with Vickey Lalwani, Rajiv was asked whether the veteran star was bothered by the age gap between him and Sonam. Rajiv shared that Naseeruddin was mindful of the fact and brought it to the director's attention, especially while shooting the sensual track Tirchi Topiwale.

Meanwhile, Recalling his interaction with Naseeruddin on set, Rajiv shared, “No. What happened was… One day, when I was discussing the script with Naseer, he just mentioned, ‘I want to bring to your notice that I have a daughter from my first marriage who is older than Sonam. Does it matter to you?’ I replied, ‘Why should it matter to me? As a couple, you two look fine. You could even have 10 children [and it won’t matter]. This is cinema; we are not doing a realistic documentary.’ Then he shared, ‘No, it’s my duty to tell you.’ He’s a very honest man.”

Notably, The director also spoke to Sonam to check whether she was comfortable playing the part opposite Naseeruddin after the age difference came up. He shared, “I told her I was informed about this and asked if she would be comfortable. She shared, ‘Why would I care? I’m dying to work with Naseeruddin because he is one of the best actors we have. Please don’t change my casting.’ She was very excited to work opposite him.”

As per the latest buzz, Rolled out in 1989, Tridev was an action thriller directed by Rajiv Rai and produced by Gulshan Rai. The movie starred Naseeruddin Shah, Sunny Deol, Jackie Shroff, Madhuri Dixit, Sonam, Sangeeta Bijlani, Anupam Kher and Amrish Puri.

In further updates, Naseeruddin Shah has continued to appear in films and streaming projects. His performance in Imtiaz Ali's Main Vaapas Aaunga collected him widespread critical acclaim. title: Congress questions RAF deployment amid Arunachal dam protests; 26 arrested in Pasighat, violence spreads to Upper Subansiri
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Arunachal Pradesh Congress Committee (APCC) on Monday criticised the reported deployment of 250 additional Rapid Action Force (RAF) personnel in areas affected by the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP), accusing the state government of relying on security measures instead of dialogue to address growing opposition to the mega-dam.

Adding to this, Arunachal Pradesh Police and CRPF personnel conduct a flag march amid tensions over the proposed Siang Multipurpose Hydroelectric Project, at Geku, in Upper Siang district, (PTI) The criticism came as East Siang police verified the arrest of 26 people, including five juveniles, in connection with last week's violence in Pasighat, while fresh incidents of vandalism and injuries to security personnel were reported during another anti-dam protest in Upper Subansiri district on Monday.

Meanwhile, APCC general secretary and spokesperson Kon Jirjo Jotham described the additional RAF deployment as "irresponsible, provocative and deeply alarming", alleging that the BJP-led government was attempting to intimidate communities raising concerns over their land, livelihoods and future.

Notably, The party warned that increasing security deployment without addressing the underlying grievances could deepen tensions across Siang, Upper Siang and East Siang districts, where opposition to the proposed 11,200-MW SUMP has intensified in recent weeks.

As per the latest buzz, While condemning the violence, arson and vandalism reported during the October 23 bandh, the Congress demanded an independent inquiry into the alleged use of tear gas against protesters at Dite Dime near Geku in Upper Siang district.

In further updates, It also called for a substantial reduction in additional RAF deployments, the rollout of detainees wherever legally justified, the withdrawal of protest-related cases wherever permissible, and the suspension of pre-feasibility report (PFR) survey activities until meaningful consultations are held with affected communities.

On top of that, The APCC further sought details of the reported ₹ 350-crore rupees Special Development and Livelihood Package, including its eligibility criteria, beneficiary lists and implementation status.

Questioning the government's handling of the unrest, the party alleged that assurances as per reports made by Chief Minister Pema Khandu during meetings with Adi youths had failed to restore public confidence.

title: Mary Kom says Priyanka Chopra-starrer biopic showed only 10% of her struggle and hard work, calls film ‘not real’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Boxer Mary Kom has criticised her 2014 biopic, starring Priyanka Chopra , saying it failed to do justice to her life and struggles. After her exit from Bigg Boss , Mary reflected on the movie and shared only 10% of her hard work and struggles were shown on screen.

Adding to this, Mary Kom was evicted from Bigg Boss Season 20 on October 24. (JioHotstar.) ‘The biopic was not real’ The boxer shared she was disappointed with the Priyanka Chopra-starrer, as she felt it did not do justice to her life and all the hard work she had put in. When asked about the possibility of a sequel to the movie, she shared, “I don’t think there should be a sequel now; everybody knows my story. My career and journey have already been shown in the movie and my book Unbreakable. However, the biopic was not real. I felt some parts of the story were not real. Only 10 percent of my struggle and hard work was shown in it. If you read the book, only then can you see my struggle and hard work. The remaining life I don’t know what will happen, but the future will be smooth, and happy, I wish that. People want to know if there will be room for love in my life. I will decide if that happens in the future.”

Meanwhile, During the same interaction, Mary spoke about her stint on Bigg Boss and shared she had shown her real self on the show. She shared, “I was not fake. Those who know me very well will know. It felt like it was the correct time. People had judged me in a different manner, but I didn’t care. I know people love me, and now they know the real Mary Kom too. I wanted to show them the person who reached here after working so hard in life. I sacrificed my entire life. Who would be able to play for 20 years? I proved with my actions how real I was. You cannot fake it for seven weeks. Sometimes I wondered how I would live like this, but I enjoyed it.”

Notably, Rolled out in 2014, Mary Kom starred Priyanka Chopra in the lead role and was based on the boxer's life. Directed by Omung Kumar, the movie depicted Mary's journey from her early years in Manipur to becoming a world champion boxer. It also explored the personal challenges she faced while balancing her sporting career,motherhood and family life. The movie was critically acclaimed and even won the National Movie Award for Best Popular Movie Providing Wholesome Entertainment.

title: Tiger Shroff firing incident: All Stars Football Club suspends Sunday sessions, seeks authorities’ advice
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After shots were fired at Tiger Shroff outside All Stars Football Club in Juhu on October 18, the incident left the Hindi movie industry in shock. Following the firing, the club, which is frequented by Tiger and other celebrities such as Ranbir Kapoor , Abhishek Bachchan and Kartik Aaryan , has put its Sunday football sessions on hold until further notice. The club's owner, Bunty Walia, verified the development and shared activities would resume once adequate security protocols are in place.

Adding to this, Shots were fired at Tiger Shroff outside All Stars Football Club. All Stars Football Club suspends Sunday sessions According to a report by News18, the club cancelled the practice session scheduled for October 25. The report also shared that Walia had put all soon-to-release activities on hold until adequate security arrangements were made. The owner shared he was seeking advice from the authorities before resuming any events.
Meanwhile, When asked whether reports about the cancellation of the Sunday sessions were true, Walia told the publication, “Yes, for the time being, until we get the security protocols in place.”

Notably, The firing incident took place on October 18 when unidentified men allegedly opened fire at Tiger Shroff's car as he was leaving the football ground in Juhu, Mumbai. The star escaped the firing unharmed, but his driver and another person sustained bullet injuries. Tiger did not suffer any bullet wounds but sustained burn injuries to his skin, which were later shown in a video rolled out by his team.
As per the latest buzz, Mumbai Police launched an investigation into the incident. A total of 11 people have been arrested in connection with the case.
In further updates, In their first statement after the attack, Tiger Shroff's team warned of legal action over AI-generated videos and false claims circulating online.

On top of that, "It has come to our attention that several social media pages and digital platforms are circulating fabricated stories, AI-generated videos and scripted narratives, falsely attributed to Tiger. These are completely false, unauthorised and intended to mislead the public.”

Urging restraint, the team emphasised, “We do not endorse, support, or have any association with such content. We urge media outlets, digital platforms and social media pages to exercise responsibility, verify information before publishing, and refrain from creating or amplifying misinformation for engagement or monetary gain."

title: ‘Elizabeth’ Rachel Shelley revisits Lagaan memories, shares unseen BTS pictures from Holi celebration on set with Ashutosh Gowariker
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Rachel Shelley , who played Elizabeth Russell in Lagaan, has shared behind-the-scenes pictures from the movie’s sets as it marks 25 years since its rollout. The star lauded director Ashutosh Gowariker for his dedication, recalling how he continued working despite an injury during the movie’s long and challenging shoot.

Adding to this, Rachel Shelley shares BTS pictures with filmmaker Ashutosh Gowariker. Rachel Shelley shares BTS pictures from Lagaan On Monday, Rachel posted on Instagram to share behind-the-scenes pictures with Ashutosh from the sets of Lagaan. One photograph showed the director explaining a scene to her, while another featured the two with their faces and clothes covered in colours, seemingly taken after they played Holi on set. The final picture showed Rachel holding a cricket bat signed by the cast and crew, which she described as a souvenir.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Rachel Shelley (@reallyrachelshelley)

Notably, Rachel added the Lagaan song Chale Chalo to the post and lauded Gowariker in her caption. She wrote, “BTS #Lagaan #lagaan25years #holi #fancydress🇮🇳🍿🎬🎥🎞️With the wonderful @ashutoshgowariker - director extraordinaire who worked through injury and a long, challenging shoot with grace, humour and complete dedication. A reassuring, calm voice and a wonderful human being.”
As per the latest buzz, She added, “And look, there's my signed cricket bat🏏, handed to me on my very last night of shooting 🎬. Ash probably has someone in his ear saying 'we have to move on...'”

In further updates, Followers were delighted by the behind-the-scenes pictures, with several sharing their appreciation for the movie and its cast. One person commented, “I am absolutely loving these BTS photos! Thank you for sharing! Long live the lovely Elizabeth.” Another wrote, “Thank you for giving us this lifetime legendary movie (feels like Indian style Titanic).” A third comment read, “He is our best, and thanks to him we got introduced to you... also one of the best.” Another person wrote, “Dear Rachel, you have acted so well in Lagaan & Ashutosh Gowariker’s direction was above par. He just hit the ball out of the ground.”

On top of that, Lagaan is a 2001 Hindi period sports drama directed by Ashutosh Gowariker and produced by Aamir Khan. Set in the late 19th century during British rule in India, the movie follows the villagers of Champaner in Gujarat, who challenge British officers to a game of cricket to escape a heavy land tax, known as lagaan, during a drought.

The movie stars Aamir Khan as Bhuvan, a villager who leads the team despite having little knowledge of cricket. Gracy Singh plays Gauri, while Rachel Shelley appears as Elizabeth Russell, the sister of British officer Captain Andrew Russell, played by Paul Blackthorne. Elizabeth helps the villagers learn the game.

title: Udta Teer box office collection day 4: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan's film slows down after opening weekend, collects ₹22.70 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Bollywood actors Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan ’s Udta Teer had a promising first weekend at the ticket-window, but Monday has brought a slowdown. The spy comedy saw its collections climb over the first three days before taking a weekday hit on October 26. While the movie started on a modest note on Friday, its Saturday and Sunday numbers offered some hope. Now, the focus is on whether it can keep audiences coming to theatres through the rest of the week, especially with other recent releases competing for attention.

Adding to this, Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s movie Udta Teer dips on Monday after a steady first weekend. Udta Teer ticket-window earnings According to trade tracker Sacnilk, Udta Teer has collected an estimated ₹ 3.15 crore rupees net in India on its first Monday. The movie is playing across 5,805 shows nationwide, but saw 67% dip on the first day of the week. Its total India net collection has reached ₹ 22.70 crore rupees .

Meanwhile, The movie opened with ₹ 4.10 crore rupees on Friday, October 23. Saturday brought a noticeable improvement, as collections rose to ₹ 7.25 crore rupees, a jump of around 76% from the opening day. The upward trend continued on Sunday, when the movie collected ₹ 8.20 crore rupees.

Notably, Udta Teer may have gained ground over its opening weekend, but its first-day collection was nowhere close to Ayushmann Khurrana's biggest openers. The star's strongest opening numbers have come from films with established franchises, familiar comic characters or considerable audience interest ahead of rollout.

As per the latest buzz, The weekend gave Udta Teer a much-needed boost after its relatively modest opening day. Monday's numbers, however, suggest that the movie will need to find a stronger weekday audience if it hopes to maintain its momentum. The next few days will be important for the Ayushmann and Sara starrer.
In further updates, Udta Teer is the directorial debut of Akash A Kaushik, who has previously worked as a writer on films including Housefull 4 , Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2 and Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3.

On top of that, The movie follows a Pakistani spy, played by Ayushmann Khurrana, who loses his memory after a blast. When he wakes up, he mistakenly believes he is an Indian Counter-Terrorism Squad officer. What follows is a series of chaotic situations as he finds himself caught in a cross-border espionage mission, with his confusion about his own identity driving much of the comedy.

Produced by Dharma Productions and Sikhya Entertainment, the movie stars Sara Ali Khan alongside Khurrana. Its ensemble cast also includes Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Suhail Nayyar, Gulshan Grover, the late Mukul Dev, Raghubir Yadav, Brijendra Kala, Supriya Pilgaonkar and Sandeep Anand.

title: Akshay Kumar, Raveena Tandon's Mohra to re-release in cinemas after 32 years on November 6 during Diwali
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The 1994 action thriller Mohra is heading back to theatres, 32 years after its original rollout. The Rajiv Rai movie will return to the big screen in a 4K remastered version on November 6, 2026, as revealed by Trimurti Films Pvt. Ltd. The re-rollout puts the Akshay Kumar , Suniel Shetty and Raveena Tandon -starrer in cinemas at the same time as Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash-led Ramayana , which is also arriving in theatres on November 5.

Adding to this, Akshay Kumar, Raveena Tandon, Suniel Shetty's Mohra returns after 32 years, re-rollout date revealed. The makers share the announcement The movie first rolled out on July 1, 1994, and went on to become one of the memorable action entertainers of its time. Trimurti Films unveiled the teaser of the re-rollout on their official YouTube channel. The description mentioned, “In a deadly game of power and betrayal, everyone could be a pawn. Experience the twists, the thrills and the songs that made MOHRA unforgettable! Celebrate 32 years of MOHRA—in cinemas near you from 6th November 2026.”

Meanwhile, Rolled out on July 1, 1994, Mohra is an action thriller directed by Rajiv Rai and produced by Gulshan Rai under Trimurti Films. The movie follows Vishal Agnihotri (Suniel Shetty), a prisoner seeking justice for his wife's murder. Journalist Roma Singh (Raveena Tandon) helps secure his rollout, but Vishal soon finds himself working for the powerful Jindal (Naseeruddin Shah), who uses him to target criminals. As Inspector Amar Saxena (Akshay Kumar) investigates the killings, a deeper conspiracy begins to unravel, putting revenge, loyalty and betrayal at the heart of the story.

Notably, The movie featured an ensemble cast, including Paresh Rawal, Gulshan Grover, Raza Murad, Sadashiv Amrapurkar, Poonam Jhawer and Kulbhushan Kharbanda. Priya Tendulkar, Avtar Gill, Kunika Sadanand, Tej Sapru and Vishwajeet Pradhan also appeared in supporting roles.

As per the latest buzz, Mohra's music was a major part of its success. Composed by Viju Shah, the soundtrack featured chartbusters such as Tu Cheez Badi Hai Mast Mast, sung by Udit Narayan and Kavita Krishnamurthy, and Tip Tip Barsa Paani, sung by Alka Yagnik and Udit Narayan. Other popular tracks included Na Kajare Ki Dhar, Subah Se Lekar, Dil Har Koi and Kaash Kahin Aisa Hota. The lyrics were penned by Anand Bakshi, Indeevar and Sameer.

In further updates, The combination of action, suspense, star power and hit music made Mohra one of the biggest Hindi releases of 1994. That year, the movie went onto become the second-highest-grossing Indian movie, behind Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!, while its soundtrack as per reports sold more than eight million units.

title: John Abraham joins Indian Superbike League as Strategic Advisor: "It’s time to get India racing"
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

With John Abraham at the centre of its launch, ISBL brings together motorsport, entertainment and pop culture to introduce a new sporting proposition to India. The movie marks the first major expression of ISBL’s identity as a sport-meets-entertainment property, built around performance, technology, personalities, competition and India’s enduring motorcycle culture.

Adding to this, Speaking about his association with ISBL, John Abraham, Strategic Advisor, Indian Superbike League, shared, "Motorcycles have always been a deeply personal passion. Being a sports team owner has also taught me what it takes to turn belief into sustained commitment. ISBL brings those two parts of my life together. I want to help young Indian riders get the opportunities they deserve and share the thrill of motorcycle racing with a whole new generation of followers. It’s time to Get India Racing.”
Meanwhile, A post shared by Indian Superbike League (@indiansuperbikeleague)

Notably, Pranav Bakre, CEO, Indian Superbike League, shared, “I come from a family of racers, so building ISBL is deeply personal. My ambition is to carry that legacy forward by creating something that opens doors for the next generation. I want people to feel the excitement of racing that has stayed with my family for decades. With racing at its heart, and music and culture bringing more people into its world, ISBL is how I want to make that happen.”

As per the latest buzz, Avi Jain, Managing Director, Dhuleva Group and Anchor Investor, ISBL, shared, “My passion for motoring draws me to racing. As an investor, what excites me is the opportunity to build a business around it that creates lasting value. With ISBL, our ambition is to build a premium, commercially sustainable league that followers return to and partners want to grow with, season after season.”

In further updates, Sanctioned by the Federation of Motor Sports Clubs of India (FMSCI), ISBL will operate as a franchise-based championship featuring two Pro categories, Amateur, Female Riders and Rookie classes. ISBL aims to create a structured competitive environment for riders while opening opportunities across teams, technical personnel, brands, creators and the wider motorsport ecosystem.
On top of that, Further details on teams, riders, race formats and venues will be revealed in due course.

title: HYBE INDIA AUDITION: Final call enters final 5 days as applications close on October 31
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The HYBE INDIA AUDITION began on March 31, with applications open until July 31 and an audition tour spanning 15 cities across India and international markets. Following the response to the audition, HYBE INDIA introduced the Final Call in September, expanding the search to eight additional cities across India. Rooted in the belief that talent can be found anywhere, the expansion aimed to go deeper into the country, reaching aspiring performers across cities, towns and communities and creating more opportunities for young women to take their first step towards the global stage. The HYBE INDIA Pop-up Parks also offered another avenue for talent to audition, taking the search beyond conventional application channels and into cultural and fan engagement spaces.

Adding to this, HYBE INDIA also collaborated with Pan-India star Rashmika Mandanna for the HYBE INDIA Audition: Final Call, with the star sharing a heartwarming video recounting her own journey and inspiring young girls to pursue their dreams, believe in their potential and discover their own universe of possibilities.

Meanwhile, As the audition enters its final days, the focus is on ensuring that aspiring performers who have been considering applying do not miss their last chance to be part of the search. The initiative invites female participants born between 2005 and 2011 across India and the global Indian diaspora to showcase their abilities across vocals, rap, dance and performance.

Notably, The search looks beyond developed talent to identify individuality, star quality and potential that can be nurtured over time through HYBE’s global artist development ecosystem. The vision is to bring together diverse cultural influences and emerging talent from across India to develop a new girl group capable of connecting with audiences across cultures and borders.

As per the latest buzz, With the application window closing on October 31, this is the final opportunity for aspiring performers to take their first step towards a potential career on the global stage. Those who have been waiting for the right moment to showcase their talent are encouraged to apply before the deadline.

In further updates, Online applications for the HYBE INDIA AUDITION: FINAL CALL close on October 31. Eligibility criteria, application details and participation guidelines are available on the official HYBE INDIA audition website. (https://india.hybeaudition.com/)

title: Anupam Kher to play Sunil Munshi’s father in Swedish-Belgian film Out of Fashion, directed by Jens Jonsson
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

The movie marks Jonsson’s return to feature filmmaking after spending seven years working in television. He previously won the Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Movie Festival for The King of Ping Pong , which brought attention to his approach to storytelling.

Adding to this, Written by Munshi, Out of Fashion centres on Armand Kaiser, a successful fashion designer whose professional and personal lives begin to collide. Based in Paris, Armand faces an ultimatum from his fashion house to create an entirely new collection within three weeks or risk losing his position.

Meanwhile, His circumstances become more complicated when he receives news from his hometown of Sala, Sweden. His father is living with irreversible dementia, while his sister needs help raising her three children. Caught between his career and his family's needs, Armand embarks on an unexpected journey towards the Himalayas to fulfil his father's final wish.

Notably, Kher will portray Armand's father, a character who plays a central role in the movie's emotional narrative. The star has worked across Indian and international cinema, with credits including Bend It Like Beckham , Lust, Caution and Silver Linings Playbook , alongside numerous Indian films.

As per the latest buzz, For Munshi, the screenplay draws on personal experiences, particularly his relationship with his father. The story also places an Indian-origin family at the centre of a Swedish production, exploring themes of cultural identity, belonging and relationships between generations.

In further updates, The supporting cast includes Bahar Pars, Helena Bergström, Krista Kosonen and Astrid Whettnall, bringing together performers from different backgrounds for the international project.

On top of that, Out of Fashion is being produced by Way Feature Films and [sic] movie, with Beside Productions, Movie i Skåne, Movie Stockholm and SVT serving as co-production partners. Scanbox Entertainment is handling distribution. The project has also received support from the Swedish Movie Institute and the Belgian Tax Shelter.
Principal photography is scheduled to take place across Stockholm, Sala, Brussels and Paris between October and December 2026. The movie is expected to receive a theatrical rollout in early 2028.

title: CBFC faces reported data security scare as confidential documents linked to over 500 films are allegedly exposed
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

As per the latest buzz, the documents remained accessible through digital archiving platforms for several days before the alleged exposure came to light. Although the actual movie files were as per reports not leaked, the availability of confidential records has prompted questions about the security measures in place to protect filmmakers' intellectual property and commercially sensitive information.

Adding to this, The documents allegedly exposed include scripts of unreleased films, details of cuts and modifications recommended during the certification process, and other material associated with movie submissions. The reported exposure of scripts is a particular concern for filmmakers, as the premature disclosure of storylines, plot developments and key scenes could affect projects before their theatrical or digital rollout.

Meanwhile, Additionally, information about scenes that were marked for deletion or modification during the certification process could become publicly accessible. Such details may reveal creative decisions and aspects of a movie that filmmakers intended to keep confidential until its rollout.

Notably, The e-Cinepramaan portal is the CBFC's online platform through which filmmakers and production houses submit applications for movie certification before releasing their projects. The system facilitates the certification process by allowing applicants to share the required documents and information digitally.

As per the latest buzz, The alleged exposure has raised concerns about the safeguards governing the information submitted through the portal. Filmmakers depend on confidentiality during the certification process, particularly when dealing with unreleased content and material that has not yet been made available to the public.
In further updates, Distribution Agreements and Licensing Details Also As per reports Exposed

On top of that, Beyond scripts and censor-related documents, the alleged incident has as per reports involved private distribution agreements and licensing fee details connected to domestic and international movie projects.

These records may contain commercially sensitive information, including revenue-sharing arrangements, intellectual property clauses and contractual terms negotiated between production houses, distributors and licensing partners. If such information becomes accessible to unauthorised parties, it could raise concerns about the confidentiality of business negotiations and agreements within the entertainment industry.

Sharing the video, Kriti wrote, “An unexpected reunion that will get you ‘Obsessed’! 😜🤭🤭 Stay Tuned!! ❤️.” The mention of "obsessed" has caught everyone's attention, with followers trying to figure out what the trio could be hinting at. Could this be about Bhediya 2, given that they howl in the video, or are they coming together for something completely different? There is no official confirmation yet.

Meanwhile, Kriti, Varun and Amar previously worked together on Bhediya, which hit theatres in November 2022. The horror-comedy followed Bhaskar, played by Varun, a road-construction contractor who is bitten by a wolf while working in the forests of Arunachal Pradesh. He soon begins experiencing a strange transformation into a werewolf. Kriti played Anika, a veterinarian who knows more about the mysterious events than she initially lets on.

Notably, Directed by Amar Kaushik, who also made Stree, Bhediya mixed supernatural elements with humour and local folklore. The movie also touched upon environmental concerns, using its werewolf story to explore the relationship between humans and nature. Its visual effects and quirky humour helped it stand out in the horror comedy space and become part of the Maddock Supernatural Universe. Bhediya collected ₹ 94.41 crore rupees worldwide in its lifetime, as per Sacnilk.

As per the latest buzz, Varun had even made a cameo in Stree 2 in 2024, where his character saves Shraddha Kapoor's character. Back in 2025, the production house Maddock Films revealed a slate of soon-to-release releases, and Bhediya 2 was officially revealed for an August 2026 rollout. But, as projects got postponed, there has been no update since then.

In further updates, Both Kriti and Varun have a busy slate of projects. Varun Dhawan was most of late seen in Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai. Before that, he starred in Border 2. Kriti Sanon also had two releases last year. She was seen in Tere Ishk Mein and most of late, Cocktail 2.

On top of that, Recent reports opened up that Kriti Sanon may be entering another horror space in Maddock Films' universe, which will be written by star Sadia Khateeb. Meanwhile, Varun is as per reports in talks to star in Yash Raj Films' first-ever horror feature movie, directed by Abhay Pannu.

A source close to the project told Hindustan Times earlier this year, “Varun has come on board as the lead for YRF’s first horror movie. Yash Raj Films (YRF) is entering the horror genre for the first time.” If things fall into place, this will be the star's first collaboration with YRF since the 2018 slice-of-life drama Sui Dhaaga, which also starred Anushka Sharma.

title: Raveena Tandon turns 54: When she cleaned studio floors as an intern, rejected films with Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Raveena Tandon's journey in Bollywood has been nothing short of extraordinary. Becoming an star was never part of her original plan, but she went on to become one of the leading female stars of the 1990s and an icon. From interning with ad filmmaker Prahlad Kakkar and cleaning studio floors to turning down several movie offers, including Darr and Prem Qaidi, Raveena took her time finding her way into the industry. She eventually made her debut opposite Salman Khan in Patthar Ke Phool (1991).

Adding to this, Despite being the daughter of filmmaker Ravi Tandon, Raveena began her professional journey behind the camera. In an interview with Mid-Day in 2022, she recalled assisting ad filmmaker Prahlad Kakkar soon after completing Class 10. While interning with him, she realised she could take up modelling and earn some pocket money.

Meanwhile, She shared, "I did start from cleaning the studio floors to wiping off vomit from the stalls floors and studio floors and stuff, and I did assist Prahlad Kakkar I think straight out of 10th Standard. Everytime when a model would not turn up on Prahlad's set, he used to say 'call Raveena,' he would ask me to do my makeup and start posing. So I thought if I have to do it why should I do it for Prahlad again and again for free, why not make some pocket money out of it, and that's exactly the thought which started the modeling. So I am in this industry actually by default, never grew up thinking that I am going to be an star."

Notably, Raveena shared that during her modelling stint, she kept receiving movie offers, but acting was not something she actively sought. In another interview, the star spoke about turning down several films, including those featuring leading stars.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking on ANI's podcast in 2023, she opened up that she was the first choice for Yash Chopra's Darr, which eventually starred Shah Rukh Khan, Sunny Deol and Juhi Chawla. However, she turned it down because she was uncomfortable with certain scenes. She shared, “Darr came to me first. It wasn't vulgar, but there were some scenes I was not comfortable with. There were things like wearing a swimming costume, and I would say, 'No, I'll not wear that.'”

In further updates, In the same conversation, Raveena shared that Prem Qaidi, which marked Karisma Kapoor's Bollywood debut, had also been offered to her. However, she turned it down because a particular scene made her uncomfortable. These were not the only films Raveena turned down. She also rejected Phool Aur Kaante, Ajay Devgn's debut movie, as she was unsure whether she wanted to pursue acting.

On top of that, Raveena eventually agreed to make her debut with Patthar Ke Phool, opposite Salman Khan. In an interview with Lehren in 2023, she recalled how her friend and fellow model Bunty Walia encouraged Salman to meet her after learning that the Dabangg star was looking for a fresh face.

Recalling how her debut movie came about, Raveena shared, "At that time, Bunty Walia, who was a friend of mine and a co-model on an ad, called Salman and shared ‘You have to meet this girl and I think she is the next big thing and you are looking for a new girl.’ Salman separately came to see my work. I think it was destiny."

title: Fresh protests erupt at Jamia Millia Islamia hours after election announcement; students detained
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Hours after Delhi's Jamia Millia Islamia revealed the resumption of student union elections after a nearly two-decade hiatus, fresh protests erupted on campus on Monday as students demanded a time-bound election process and the appointment of a chief election officer.

Adding to this, Students of Jamia Millia Islamia stage a protest demanding entry to their campus amid an ongoing strike, as security personnel allow only hostel residents to enter the campus in New Delhi. ( Arvind Yadav/ Hindustan Times) Earlier in the day, around 100 female students entered the campus through different gates, with some gathering outside Gate no. 7, while several protesters were also detained by the Delhi Police. The students raised slogans of “Delhi Police, go back” as tensions continued over the restoration of the Jamia Millia Islamia Students’ Union (JMISU), whose elections have not been held since 2006.

Meanwhile, “We want the administration to appoint a chief election officer and fast-track the election process. Until then, the protest will continue,” Asif Khan, a student at JMI’s Faculty of Law, told HT.
Notably, The absence of an elected student body has left students without an effective channel to communicate their grievances to the university administration, a 20-year-old student told HT.

As per the latest buzz, “From admissions to hostel seats to food in the mess, there is a problem with everything at Jamia. We don’t have anyone between us, the students, and the Jamia administration. We want a union to bridge that gap,” the student shared.

In further updates, On Monday, the university administration opened up that student union elections would be held within 15 days of the approval of the students’ union constitution, HT reported earlier.

On top of that, The announcement came after nearly two weeks of protests and hunger strikes on campus over the restoration of the JMISU. The decision followed nearly five hours of negotiations between student representatives and university officials. The administration also revoked suspension orders and show-cause notices issued to some students and assured an inquiry into the conduct of security personnel during the protests.

“The Jamia Millia Islamia Students Union Election will be held after 15 days, from the date of approval of the constitution of the students’ union. Suspension and show-cause notices issued to students are hereby revoked. A committee shall be constituted to enquire into the actions of security staff during the period of protest,” JMI registrar Professor Mahtab Alam Rizvi shared in a note.

title: Yash to handle Karnataka distribution of Ranbir Kapoor starrer Ramayana under Monster Mind Creations
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star, who plays Ravana and co-produces the movie, has expanded his banner’s operations with a dedicated theatrical distribution wing for the Karnataka market.

Adding to this, With Yash commanding a substantial following in Karnataka and across India, Monster Mind Creations’ involvement in the regional distribution of Ramayana is expected to play an important role in shaping the movie’s theatrical rollout in the state. The arrangement places the star’s own banner at the centre of the movie’s Karnataka rollout strategy, as the makers work towards bringing the ambitious mythological drama to audiences across multiple markets.

Meanwhile, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, known for films such as Dangal and Chhichhore , Ramayana is being developed as a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Indian epic. The movie features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Yash as Ravana. The ensemble brings together prominent actors from different movie industries for a project mounted on a large scale.

Notably, The Karnataka distribution arrangement forms part of a wider rollout strategy involving established partners across domestic and international territories. Sony Pictures is handling international distribution, while Dharma Productions will oversee the Hindi-speaking markets in North India. Telugu producer Dil Raju is associated with distribution across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, while Think Studios will handle Tamil Nadu. E4 Entertainment, led by Mukesh Mehta, is responsible for the Kerala market.

As per the latest buzz, Jointly produced by Prime Focus Studios and Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is being envisioned as a large-scale theatrical experience, with visual effects and production design forming key aspects of its cinematic presentation. Yash’s dual involvement as an star and producer, alongside his banner’s distribution responsibilities in Karnataka, further expands his role in the project.

In further updates, Ramayana: Part 1 is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical rollout on November 5, 2026, across multiple languages and premium large formats. With the Karnataka distribution now assigned to Monster Mind Creations, the movie’s rollout plans continue to take shape across regional and international markets.

title: Madhoo is in love with Rashmika Mandanna owning her South Indian accent on Koffee With Karan; recalls being judged for it in Bollywood
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Madhoo , who has acted in all South Indian languages and Hindi, spoke up in support of Rashmika Mandanna owning her accent on Karan Johar’s talk show, Koffee With Karan. Recalling feeling judged for the same when she worked in Bollywood, the star shared that it took her over 30 years to be comfortable with her accent, as Rashmika is today. In a video posted on her Instagram, Madhoo also shared that she had to work extra hard to mask her accent when working in Hindi films.

Adding to this, In a long video posted on her Instagram, Madhoo remarked that she watched Rashmika’s KWK episode. “The way she dealt with her accent, criticism, I just loved it. She laughs about it, she accepts it, she owns it. Calls herself a South Indian. And she says, so? I am a South Indian. And I have a South Indian accent. And she’s so cool about it,” she shared, adding, “And then she says, I have a desire to be a Karan Johar star and then she laughs and says, but you know what? I’ll allow him to use a dubbing artist. And she was so cool about it. And I’m really in love with that.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Madhoo Shah (@madhoo_rockstar)

Notably, Madhoo also shared that, years ago, when she acted in Hindi films, she felt judged. But it also meant that she worked hard to mask it. “I was so afraid of the South Indian judgments that I was getting, and I thought I would get. And I’d learnt harder and harder. I tried to get a Urdu teacher, and I bettered myself in Hindi. Anything and everything, so that I don’t get caught out in an accent. If anybody even spotted a little bit of an accent in my tone, I would get all flustered, and I would work harder at it. And I felt very proud when people would say that your Hindi is even better than a Hindi-wala.”

As per the latest buzz, She shared that while that’s what her journey was like, she’s proud to say she’s a South Indian today. “And if I do make a mistake in the Hindi language, and if my accent does have that thickness of a South Indian, I’m okay with it. But it took me all of 30 years, 35 years to come here. And Rashmika, great power to you, girl. I just loved it. That you own it, you laugh about it, and you are really a star,” shared Madhoo.

In further updates, Criticism has followed Rashmika since the beginning of her career in Bollywood, particularly over her Kodava Takk accent coming through while speaking Hindi. When asked about it on KWK, she shared, “Ever since I started working in the movie industry, you know, I've been criticised or trolled for one thing or the other, like either my performance, or the language, or the acting, or just the accent, or anything. So for me, I never wanted to sort of put a barrier for myself. I didn't want to just work in one industry. I wanted to work in them all. I didn't want to speak just one language. I wanted to speak all languages.”
On top of that, Madhoo most of late starred in the Malayalam movie Chinna Chinna Aasai and the Hindi movie Governor. Rashmika last starred in Ranabaali in Telugu and Cocktail 2 in Hindi.

title: Daler Mehndi controversy ends as Uttarakhand Minister Subodh Uniyal apologises; Mika Singh’s team reacts
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The dispute erupted after the minister interrupted Daler Mehndi’s performance at a religious fair in Uttarakhand.

Adding to this, Reacting to the development, Mika Singh’s team rolled out an official statement expressing hope that the matter could now be put behind them. The statement read, "We appreciate that Subodh Uniyal ji has apologised to Daler Mehndi paaji over a telephonic conversation regarding the unfortunate incident. Respecting artists and their dignity is extremely important. Daler paaji is a senior artist who has contributed immensely to the music industry, and every artist deserves to be treated with respect. We hope this matter can now be put behind us and everyone can move forward with mutual respect and understanding."

Meanwhile, The dispute originated at the Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in New Tehri, Uttarakhand, where Daler Mehndi had been invited to perform. During the event, Uniyal interrupted the singer from the stage and questioned his conduct in front of the audience. The minister alleged that Mehndi was intoxicated, was not performing properly and was lip-syncing at a religious event being held during Navratri.

Notably, The incident subsequently triggered considerable criticism from members of the entertainment industry, with several artists expressing concern over the public treatment of a senior musician. The episode also sparked a wider conversation about the respect and dignity that performers deserve, irrespective of the circumstances surrounding a live performance.

As per the latest buzz, As the disagreement escalated, Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami intervened in an effort to ease tensions between the parties. Before Uniyal's direct apology to Mehndi, Mika Singh had spoken about his interaction with the Chief Minister, appreciating the latter's approach to the situation.

In further updates, Mika described Dhami as a humble and approachable leader who had communicated with him warmly and respectfully. According to the singer, the Chief Minister had also expressed regret over the incident on behalf of the cabinet minister.

On top of that, While acknowledging Dhami's gesture, Mika clarified that he did not hold the Chief Minister responsible for what had transpired. He had as per reports told Dhami that there was no need for him to apologise, as he had not personally been involved in the incident. However, Mika maintained that the minister who had interrupted the performance needed to address the matter directly with Daler Mehndi.
Mika also opened up that Dhami had invited both brothers to visit Uttarakhand and perform in the state again, signalling his willingness to help restore the relationship with the music fraternity.

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Nick Jonas (@nickjonas)

Notably, Nick of late appeared on a podcast with his mother-in-law and Priyanka’s mother, Madhu Chopra. During their conversation, he discussed the factors that led to the Jonas Brothers’ breakup in 2013, before their eventual reunion in 2019.

As per the latest buzz, “There was a fraying that was happening. From our last album till the time we broke up, it was a combination of growing up, being in a pressure cooker of having reached this level of success and having not quite reached that success for a number of years, finding that we weren't extending our collaborators because we were afraid that maybe if we reached out, people wouldn't want to work with us,” he shared.

In further updates, He also spoke about his biggest flaw and his tendency to overthink certain aspects of the creative process. “My major flaw is my tendency to overthink certain things in the creative process and I always describe it as I am tightening the screw until eventually the wood breaks and you reach a sweet spot where you are giving as much effort as you can but you can also overcook it. So, just find that perfect balance where you have done your best that you feel you can do and leave it in the hands of others,” he shared.

On top of that, Nick Jonas and Priyanka Chopra first met at the Vanity Fair Oscars party in February 2017 and they started dating by May 2018. The couple got engaged in July 2018 and tied the knot in December that year in lavish ceremonies in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, celebrating both Christian and Hindu wedding traditions. In January 2022, they revealed the birth of their daughter, Malti Marie, via surrogacy.

title: Ramayana advance booking crosses ₹20 crore 10 days before release; Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's film sees houseful shows in Telugu
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Advance bookings for Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana Part One are going steady after a smash hit start on Dussehra. The pre-sales for the ambitious adaptation began 15 days before its scheduled rollout, ahead of Diwali. The first day a bumper response for the tickets. The pace his since plateaued, but the momentum remains positive for the big-budget spectacle.

Adding to this, Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana has got off to a promising start in advance bookings. How Ramayana pre-sales are faring Ramayana has reached the ₹ 10 crore rupees mark in advance bookings in India alone, selling over 2 lakh tickets for its opening day domestically. Initially, the Hindi version was accounting for almost all of the pre-sales collections, but over the last two days, more Kannada and Telugu shows have begun to open. The Hindi version still accounts for 87% of the movie’s advance bookings. The Kannada version, which is now open in around 100 screens, has crossed the ₹ 1 crore rupees mark, with some centres already reporting up to 80% occupancy for the morning shows. The Telugu shows have opened in only around 10-15 screens, but are still hurtling towards the ₹ 40 lakh mark.

Meanwhile, What has helped Ramayana’s case is the pre-sales buzz overseas. In North America, the movie will have paid previews on November 4, the eve of its rollout. According to Sacnilk, the movie has sold $550K in tickets for those paid previews. In addition, Ramayana has grossed $400K for the rollout day from overseas territories. This brings the movie’s worldwide advance-booking gross to ₹ 20 crore rupees by the end of October 25, ten days before its rollout.

Notably, Only a few regional Ramayana shows have opened for advance bookings so far. The Hindi version is already selling tickets for over 4200 shows across India for day 1. In comparison, the Kannada and Telugu versions have just over 400 shows combined. Yet, the Telugu version is seeing breakneck bookings. According to Sacnilk, four of the 44 Telugu shows are already houseful. On-the-ground tracking indicates that the number across languages may exceed a dozen after accounting for blocked seats.

As per the latest buzz, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part movie. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first part is scheduled for worldwide rollout on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2027. The films will rollout in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam across India.

In further updates, Sony Pictures will handle global distribution, excluding India, while Dharma Productions will distribute the movie in the Hindi-speaking market. The movie is also planned for a worldwide IMAX rollout.

title: Asin’s 7-year-old daughter Arin speaks 12 languages, Rahul Sharma reveals they raised her without TV or phones
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

title: Jamia students reject university’s appeal to end protest, say order on students’ union restoration is ‘ambiguous’
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Students of Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) on Monday rejected an appeal by the university to call off the protests, saying the notice issued to them failed to provide a clear and unambiguous announcement regarding the restoration of the students’ union, leaving several key concerns unaddressed. They reiterated that their agitation would continue.

Adding to this, Students of Jamia Millia Islamia protesting outside university gate on Sunday. ((Arvind Yadav/Hindustan Times)) The rejection comes after Jamia Millia Islamia Registrar Mahatab Alam Rizvi arrived at the University around 4:30am to engage in a dialogue with protesting students amid the ongoing agitation demanding the restoration of the students’ union .

Meanwhile, The Registrar arrived with an official notice and shared the order with the students, urging them to call off their protest, claiming that their demands had been met, students shared. However, the notice failed to provide a clear and unambiguous announcement regarding the restoration of the students’ union, leaving several key concerns unaddressed.
Notably, In the order issued on Monday, the university administration shared the elections would be held within 15 days of the approval of the students’ union constitution.

As per the latest buzz, “The Jamia Millia Islamia Students’ Union Election will be held after 15 days, from the date of approval of the constitution of the Students’ Union of Jamia Millia Islamia,” the order shared, news agency ANI reported.
In further updates, HT could not independently verify the contents of the order.

On top of that, The students expressed dissatisfaction with what they described as an unclear and inadequate order, arguing that it did not specify a timeline for the approval of the students’ union constitution or the conduct of elections. The notice also made no mention of the resignation of the Proctor, another demand raised by the protesting students.

Rejecting the administration’s attempt to call off the agitation on the basis of the notice, the students maintained that assurances without concrete decisions and a clear roadmap could not be treated as fulfilment of their demands.
